The Son of Man is named eternally before Yahuah (God) of Spirits and the Head of Days—even before creation—serving as support/light/hope for the faithful, object of universal worship, hidden/chosen by Yahuah (God). Wisdom reveals him to the righteous who hate unrighteousness and are saved in His name. It ends with kings/mighty begging respite from coming judgment, linking back to prior chapters’ themes of their downfall. Verse 1: Fountain of inexhaustible righteousness, surrounded by wisdom springs; thirsty drink, filled with wisdom, dwell with righteous/holy/elect. Cross-refs: Psalm 36:9 (fountain of life… in Your light see light); Isaiah 55:1 (ho, every one that thirsts… come to waters); John 4:14 (water springing up to everlasting life); Revelation 22:1,17 (river of water of life… let him that is athirst come); Proverbs 18:4 (words of a man’s mouth deep waters… fountain of wisdom). Verse 2: At that hour Son of Man named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, name before Head of Days. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:13–14 (Son of Man… given dominion… everlasting); John 1:1–2 (Word was with God… in beginning); Micah 5:2 (origins from of old, from ancient days); Revelation 13:8 (Lamb slain from foundation of world); 1 Peter 1:19–20 (foreknown before foundation… manifested). Verse 3: Before sun/signs/stars created, His name named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Proverbs 8:22–31 (Wisdom possessed… before earth… when He prepared heavens); John 17:5 (glory had with You before world was); Ephesians 1:4 (chosen in Him before foundation); Colossians 1:15–17 (before all things… by Him all consist). Verse 4: Staff to righteous (stay, not fall); light of Gentiles; hope of troubled heart. Cross-refs: Isaiah 42:6 (light to Gentiles); Isaiah 49:6 (light to Gentiles… salvation to ends of earth); Luke 2:32 (light to lighten Gentiles); Psalm 27:1 (Yahuah (God) my light… salvation); Hebrews 6:18–19 (hope as anchor for soul). Verse 5: All on earth fall down, worship, praise, bless, celebrate song to Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Philippians 2:10–11 (every knee bow… confess Jesus Christ is Lord); Revelation 5:13 (every creature… blessing… to Him on throne and to Lamb); Psalm 86:9 (all nations… worship… glorify Your name); Zechariah 14:16 (nations worship King Yahuah (God)). Verse 6: Chosen and hidden before Him, before world creation, for evermore. Cross-refs: 1 Peter 1:20 (foreordained before foundation… manifested); Ephesians 3:9 (mystery hidden from ages… in God); Colossians 1:26 (mystery hid from ages… now made manifest). Verse 7: Wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits revealed Him to holy/righteous; preserved their lot; they hated/despised world of unrighteousness, its works/ways in name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits; saved in His name, according to His pleasure regarding their life. Cross-refs: James 4:4 (friendship with world enmity with God); 1 John 2:15–17 (love not world… world passes away); John 17:14–16 (not of world… kept through Your name); Psalm 91:14 (set love on Me… deliver… honor); Acts 4:12 (no other name… saved). Verse 8: In these days kings/mighty possessing earth implore Him to grant little respite from angels of punishment to whom delivered. Cross-refs: Revelation 6:15–17 (kings/mighty hide… from wrath of Lamb); Isaiah 2:19–21 (men hide in rocks… for terror of Yahuah (God)); Psalm 2:10–12 (kings… serve Yahuah (God) with fear… kiss Son); Revelation 19:11–21 (kings gathered… slain by sword from mouth). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 48 exalts the eternal, pre-creation naming and role of the Son of Man—chosen/hidden by Yahuah (God) of Spirits, source of wisdom/light/hope, worthy of all worship. The righteous are sustained by drinking from His fountain, saved in Yahuah’s name for hating unrighteousness. Contrast: the powerful beg mercy too late from judgment angels. This foreshadows NT Messiah (the Word named before creation, light to nations, name above all). Discern: Does a teaching point to clinging to Yahuah’s name for salvation, despising worldly unrighteousness, and trusting the eternal Son of Man? Or does it compromise with kings/mighty/power structures that deny Him? The faithful drink wisdom, stand firm, worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits—eternal hope vs. temporary respite begged in fear (Philippians 2:9–11; Revelation 5:9–14). Hang on His name; the fountain never fails.

chapters.title: Wisdom Poured Out; the Elect One’s Glory and Judgment

verses.text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.

For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.
And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (God) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 49 continues exalting the Elect One (Son of Man from preceding chapters): wisdom flows abundantly like water, His glory eternal and unfailing. He masters all righteous secrets; unrighteousness vanishes like a fleeting shadow with no lasting place, because the Elect One stands before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in everlasting glory and might across generations. The spirits of wisdom, insight, understanding, might, and the righteous departed dwell in Him. He judges hidden things perfectly—no lies can stand before Him—as chosen by Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ good pleasure. This deepens the portrait of the named-before-creation, Spirit-filled judge who eradicates evil and upholds righteousness eternally. Verse 1: Wisdom poured out like water; glory never fails before Him forevermore. Cross-refs: Isaiah 11:2 (Spirit of wisdom/understanding… rest upon Him); Proverbs 1:20–23 (wisdom cries aloud… pours out spirit); Joel 2:28 (pour out My Spirit on all flesh); John 7:38–39 (rivers of living water… Spirit); Isaiah 55:1 (come… buy wine and milk without money). Verse 2: Mighty in secrets of righteousness; unrighteousness disappears as shadow, no continuance; Elect One stands before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, glory forever, might to all generations. Cross-refs: Isaiah 9:6–7 (government on His shoulder… increase of His government… no end); Psalm 72:17 (His name endures forever… continue as long as sun); Hebrews 1:3 (upholding all things by word of power… sat down at right hand); Revelation 1:18 (alive forevermore… keys of death/hell); Daniel 7:14 (dominion everlasting… shall not pass away). Verse 3: In Him dwells spirit of wisdom, insight, understanding/might, and spirit of those fallen asleep in righteousness. Cross-refs: Isaiah 11:2–3 (Spirit of Yahuah (God)… wisdom/understanding/counsel/might/knowledge/fear of Yahuah (God)); Colossians 2:3 (in Him hidden all treasures of wisdom/knowledge); Romans 8:9–11 (Spirit of Him who raised Jesus… dwells in you… quicken mortal bodies); 1 Corinthians 2:10–11 (Spirit searches deep things of God); Ephesians 1:17 (Spirit of wisdom/revelation in knowledge of Him). Verse 4: Judges secret things; none utters lying word before Him; Elect One before Yahuah (God) of Spirits according to His good pleasure. Cross-refs: Hebrews 4:13 (all things naked/open to eyes of Him… give account); 1 Corinthians 4:5 (judge hidden things of darkness… manifest counsels of hearts); Psalm 96:13 (judge world in righteousness… peoples with truth); John 5:22,30 (Father judges no man… Son judges… as hears); Revelation 19:11 (judges/makes war in righteousness… called Faithful/True). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 49 portrays the Elect One as the embodiment of divine wisdom and Spirit-filled authority—standing eternally before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, eradicating unrighteousness completely, judging hidden truths without deception possible. Wisdom pours endlessly; glory and might endure forever. This foreshadows the Messiah’s role: Spirit-anointed judge (Isaiah 11), eternal dominion (Daniel 7), no lie before Him (as in NT truth). Discern: Teachings that honor the Elect One’s perfect judgment, Spirit indwelling, and victory over unrighteousness align with this vision. Beware those that downplay hidden sins, compromise with shadows of evil, or deny salvation through Yahuah’s chosen. The righteous “fallen asleep” find rest in Him (1 Thessalonians 4:13–14); cling to Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name—the Elect One’s glory never fades, and truth prevails (John 14:6; Revelation 19:11). Hang upon His name; wisdom flows to those who seek it.

chapters.title: The Glorification and Victory of the Righteous: the Repentance of the Gentiles

verses.text: And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect, And the light of days shall abide upon them, And glory and honour shall turn to the holy,

On the day of affliction on which evil shall have been treasured up against the sinners. And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits: And He will cause the others to witness (this) That they may repent And forgo the works of their hands.
They shall have no honour through the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, Yet through His name shall they be saved, And Yahuah (God) of Spirits will have compassion on them, For His compassion is great.
And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 50 highlights the dramatic reversal: a transformative change for the holy and elect—eternal light, glory, and honor—on the day of affliction when evil’s stored-up consequences hit the sinners. The righteous triumph in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, witnessing leads some (Gentiles/others) to repent and abandon evil works. Yet, those without true honor in Yahuah’s name are saved only through His great compassion. Yahuah (God) judges righteously; unrighteousness cannot stand in His glory, and the unrepentant perish. Finally, no more mercy for the hardened, declared by Yahuah (God) of Spirits Himself. This bridges judgment themes (prior chapters) with mercy’s limit and victory for the faithful. Verse 1: Change for holy/elect; light of days abides; glory/honor to the holy. Cross-refs: Isaiah 60:1–3 (arise shine… glory of Yahuah (God) risen upon you… nations come to light); Revelation 21:23–24 (no need of sun… glory of God enlightens it… nations walk in light); Psalm 97:11 (light sown for righteous… gladness for upright); Isaiah 58:8 (light break forth… glory of Yahuah (God) rear guard). Verse 2: Day of affliction with evil treasured against sinners; righteous victorious in name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits; others witness to repent, forgo evil hands’ works. Cross-refs: Romans 2:5 (treasure up wrath… day of wrath/revelation); Joel 2:11–13 (day of Yahuah (God) great/terrible… rend heart… turn/repent); Acts 17:30–31 (times of ignorance overlooked… now commands repent… judge world in righteousness); Revelation 11:18 (nations angry… time for dead judged… reward prophets/saints… destroy destroyers). Verse 3: No honor through name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, yet saved through His name; Yahuah (God) of Spirits compassion great. Cross-refs: Psalm 86:15 (compassionate/mercy… great lovingkindness/truth); Ephesians 2:4–5 (rich in mercy… great love… made alive); Titus 3:5 (not works… mercy… saved); Psalm 103:8–11 (merciful/gracious… compassion… high as heavens); Joel 2:13 (gracious/mercy… repent of evil). Verse 4: Righteous in judgement; unrighteousness not maintain in His glory; unrepentant perish before Him. Cross-refs: Psalm 1:5–6 (wicked not stand in judgement… way of wicked perish); Nahum 1:3–7 (Yahuah (God) slow to anger… great power… way in whirlwind… refuge in day of trouble); Revelation 6:15–17 (kings hide… from face of Him on throne… great day of wrath); Psalm 5:4–5 (no evil dwell with You… workers of iniquity not stand). Verse 5: No mercy henceforth on them, saith Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 13:14 (dash… no pity/spare/compassion); Ezekiel 7:4,9 (eye not spare… recompense ways); Hosea 1:6 (no more mercy… not be my people); Romans 9:15,18 (mercy on whom I will… hardens whom He will); Hebrews 10:26–31 (no sacrifice remains… fearful expectation of judgement… falls into hands of living God). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 50 reveals Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ dual nature—great compassion offering repentance/salvation through His name, yet finality in judgment: no endless mercy for the unrepentant; evil’s day ends, righteous victorious with abiding light/glory. Witnessing the elect’s triumph prompts some to turn from wicked works, but hardened hearts perish. This echoes NT mercy (repent while time) vs. coming wrath (no more pity). Discern: Teachings that proclaim Yahuah’s name for victory/salvation, call to repentance, and warn of irreversible judgment align here. Beware dilutions of mercy without repentance or judgments without compassion’s limit. The holy/elect endure affliction to glory; cling to Yahuah’s name—victory is in it, compassion great, but unrighteousness cannot stand before Him (James 2:13; 2 Peter 3:9). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; change comes, light abides forever.

chapters.title: The Resurrection of the Dead, and the Separation by the Judge of the Righteous and the Wicked

verses.text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes. 5a. For in those days the Elect One shall arise,
And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.

And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.

And in those days shall the mountains leap like rams, And the hills also shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk, And the faces of [all] the angels in heaven shall be lighted up with joy. 5b. And the earth shall rejoice, c. And the righteous shall dwell upon it, d. And the elect shall walk thereon.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 51 unveils the grand resurrection and final separation: earth, Sheol, and hell return the dead; the Elect One arises to choose/save the righteous and holy as their day draws near. He sits on Yahuah’s throne (My throne), pouring secrets of wisdom/counsel given and glorified by Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Creation rejoices—mountains/hills leap in joy, angels’ faces shine, earth glad—as righteous dwell and elect walk upon it. This climaxes Parables’ judgment themes: resurrection for vindication, Elect One enthroned as judge/savior, cosmic celebration for the faithful. Verse 1: Earth gives back entrusted; Sheol/hell return received/owed (resurrection of dead). Cross-refs: Daniel 12:2 (many asleep in dust awake… everlasting life/contempt); John 5:28–29 (all in graves hear voice… come forth… resurrection life/judgment); Revelation 20:13 (sea/death/hell gave up dead… judged every man); Isaiah 26:19 (dead live… earth cast out dead); Hosea 13:14 (ransom from power of Sheol… redeem from death). Verse 5a: In those days Elect One arises. Cross-refs: Isaiah 11:1–2 (shoot from Jesse… Spirit rest); Psalm 110:1 (sit at right hand); Acts 17:31 (appointed day… judge by Man ordained… raised from dead); Matthew 24:30–31 (Son of Man coming… elect gathered). Verse 2: Elect One chooses righteous/holy from among them; day nigh for salvation. Cross-refs: Matthew 25:31–34 (Son of Man throne… separate sheep/goats… inherit kingdom); 2 Thessalonians 2:13–14 (chosen from beginning… salvation through sanctification); 1 Peter 2:9 (chosen generation… royal priesthood… show praises); Revelation 7:14–17 (great tribulation… washed robes… before throne). Verse 3: Elect One sits on My throne; mouth pours secrets of wisdom/counsel; Yahuah (God) of Spirits gave/glorified him. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:13–14 (Son of Man… everlasting dominion); Matthew 28:18 (all authority given); Revelation 3:21 (sit with Me on My throne… as overcame/sat with Father); Isaiah 9:6–7 (government… Wonderful Counsellor… increase no end); John 17:22 (glory given… one even as We are one). Verse 4: Mountains leap like rams, hills skip like lambs; angels’ faces lighted with joy. Cross-refs: Psalm 114:4–6 (mountains skipped like rams… hills like lambs… tremble earth at presence of Yahuah (God)); Psalm 98:7–9 (seas roar… floods clap… hills sing… judge earth); Isaiah 55:12 (mountains/trees sing… peace); Luke 19:40 (stones cry out if silent). Verse 5b–d: Earth rejoices; righteous dwell upon it; elect walk thereon. Cross-refs: Isaiah 65:17–19 (new heavens/earth… rejoice/joy forever… no more weeping); Revelation 21:1–4 (new heaven/earth… no more death/sorrow… God dwells with them); Psalm 37:29 (righteous inherit land… dwell forever); Isaiah 60:21 (people righteous… inherit land forever… branch of planting). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 51 proclaims resurrection hope—the dead return, Elect One arises enthroned by Yahuah (God) of Spirits, choosing/saving righteous amid cosmic joy. No more Sheol’s hold; salvation’s day arrives for holy, with wisdom poured and earth renewed. This foreshadows NT resurrection (John 5), Son of Man’s throne (Matthew 25), new creation (Revelation 21). Discern: Teachings affirming bodily resurrection, Elect One’s authority from Yahuah (God), vindication of righteous, and joy in judgment align. Beware denials of resurrection or separation of wicked/righteous. The faithful walk on rejoicing earth—cling to Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name; the Elect One chooses, glorifies, and the day draws nigh (1 Corinthians 15:51–54; 1 Thessalonians 4:16–17). Hang upon Yahuah’s name—resurrection and glory await!

chapters.title: The Seven Metal Mountains and the Valley of Judgment

verses.text: And after those days in that place where I had seen all the visions of that which is hidden—for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and they had borne me towards the west—

There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.

And all these things shall be in the presence of the Elect One As wax before the fire, And as the water which comes down from above upon those mountains, And they shall become powerless before his feet.
And in that place mine eyes saw how they made these mountains into a deep valley, And the valley was very deep, wide and smooth.

And in that place mine eyes saw how they made these mountains into a deep valley, And the valley was very deep, wide and smooth. (Note: Some editions combine or note minor textual overlaps here; Charles has repetition for emphasis on the valley’s formation.)
And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved, And the days of their lives shall be at an end, And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.

And in those days the angels shall return And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes: They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them, And they shall rouse them from their thrones, That they may break forth as lions from their lairs, And as hungry wolves among their flocks.
And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones [And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway:]
But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 52 describes Enoch’s vision of hidden future things in the west: six mountains of metals (iron, copper, silver, gold, soft metal/bronze-like, lead) symbolizing worldly powers/kingdoms that melt like wax before the Elect One (as water over mountains, powerless at His feet). These form a deep, wide, smooth valley of judgment. The valley fills with the elect/beloved as wicked lives end and deception ceases. Angels stir eastern kings (Parthians/Medes) to unrest, rousing them like lions/wolves to tread the land of the elect—but the righteous city hinders their advance. This depicts worldly empires’ collapse before the Elect One, judgment valley for the wicked, protection for the faithful amid chaos. Verse 1: After those days, in hidden visions place (carried west by whirlwind). Cross-refs: Ezekiel 1:4 (whirlwind from north… vision); 2 Kings 2:11 (Elijah whirlwind to heaven); Revelation 1:10 (in Spirit on Lord’s day… heard voice); Acts 8:39–40 (Spirit caught away Philip). Verse 2: Secret things of heaven: mountains of iron/copper/silver/gold/soft metal/lead. Cross-refs: Daniel 2:32–35 (image head gold… chest silver… belly bronze… legs iron… feet iron/clay… stone smashes… becomes mountain); Zechariah 6:1 (four chariots… mountains of bronze); Revelation 17:9–10 (seven hills/kings… one is). Verse 3: Mountains powerless like wax before fire/water from above before Elect One’s feet. Cross-refs: Micah 1:4 (mountains melt… valleys split… wax before fire); Psalm 97:5 (mountains melt like wax at Yahuah’s presence); Nahum 1:5–6 (mountains quake… earth heaves… Who stands before indignation?); Revelation 20:11 (earth/heaven flee… no place found). Verse 4–5: Mountains made into deep/wide/smooth valley. Cross-refs: Isaiah 40:4 (valleys exalted… mountains/low hills made low… rough places plain); Zechariah 14:10 (whole land plain… from Geba to Rimmon); Luke 3:5 (every valley filled… mountains/low hills brought low… crooked straight). Verse 6: Valley filled with elect/beloved; wicked days end, no more leading astray. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:10 (devil… lake of fire… tormented day/night forever); Isaiah 65:20 (no more infant days/aged… sinner accursed); Revelation 21:4 (no more death/sorrow/crying/pain… former passed away). Verse 7: Angels return east against Parthians/Medes; stir kings to unrest, rouse from thrones like lions/wolves. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 51:20–23 (hammer/weapon… shatter nations/kings/horses/chariots); Daniel 7:5 (bear… three ribs… devour much flesh); Revelation 16:12 (Euphrates dried… kings from east prepared); Isaiah 13:17 (Medes stirred… no regard silver/gold). Verse 8: Tread land of elect; become threshing-floor/highway. Cross-refs: Isaiah 41:15–16 (threshing sledge… mountains/hills chaff… wind carry away); Micah 4:13 (Arise/thresh… horns iron/hoofs bronze… crush many peoples); Joel 3:13 (put sickle… harvest ripe… tread winepress… wickedness great). Verse 9: City of righteous hinders horses. Cross-refs: Zechariah 12:2–4 (cup of reeling… horses smitten with panic/blindness); Psalm 20:7 (some trust chariots/horses… we trust name of Yahuah (God)); Isaiah 31:3 (Egypt men not God… horses flesh not spirit… stumble/fall); Revelation 19:19–21 (kings/horses gathered… beast/armies slain by sword from mouth). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 52 shows worldly powers (metal mountains/kings) melting/powerless before the Elect One—empires collapse into judgment valley, filled only with elect as deception ends. Angels provoke eastern chaos, but righteous city stands firm, hindering invasion. This warns of temporary kingdoms vs. eternal elect protection. Foreshadows Daniel’s stone smashing image, Revelation’s beast armies defeated. Discern: Teachings exalting Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ Elect One over human powers, promising vindication for faithful amid turmoil, align. Beware idolizing nations/metal (wealth/power) that wax melt. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the valley fills with beloved, wicked tread no more, city hinders foes (Psalm 46:5–7; Zechariah 2:5). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; hidden visions reveal victory!

chapters.title: The Deep Valley of Judgment and the Instruments of Punishment

verses.text: There mine eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, And all who dwell on the dry ground and the sea and the islands shall bring gifts and offerings and acknowledgments to Him.
But the valley shall not become full.

And their hands commit lawless deeds, And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress: Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.
And I saw there all the angels of punishment abiding (there) And preparing all the instruments of Satan.
And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: ‘For whom are they preparing these instruments?’
And he said unto me: ’These they prepare for the kings and the mighty and the exalted, And for those who dwell on the earth, That they may thereby be destroyed.’

chapters.commentary: Chapter 53 depicts a terrifying vision of judgment: a deep valley with open mouths (abyss-like for punishment), where sinners’ gifts/offerings fail to fill it or avert doom. The wicked oppress and devour lawlessly, yet they face destruction and eternal banishment before Yahuah (God) of Spirits—perishing forever. Enoch sees angels of punishment preparing Satan’s instruments (chains, tools of torment). The angel explains these are for kings/mighty/exalted and earth-dwellers, to destroy them. This intensifies prior chapters’ themes: worldly powers’ collapse, no escape for oppressors, final eradication of evil before Yahuah’s face. Verse 1: Deep valley with open mouths; all on dry ground/sea/islands bring gifts/offerings/acknowledgments to Him—but valley not full (insufficient to avert judgment). Cross-refs: Isaiah 2:10–21 (hide in dust… from terror of Yahuah (God)… lofty humbled); Revelation 6:15–17 (kings/mighty hide in caves/rocks… from wrath of Lamb); Psalm 49:6–9 (riches redeem no soul… ransom costly… never enough); Micah 6:6–8 (burnt offerings/calves… thousands rams… not delight… do justice/love mercy). Verse 2: (Implied continuation; valley remains unfilled despite offerings.) Cross-refs: (Ties to v1; see above for sacrificial inadequacy.) Verse 3: Hands commit lawless deeds; sinners devour oppressed; sinners destroyed/banished from earth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, perish forever. Cross-refs: Psalm 37:9–11,38 (evildoers cut off… righteous inherit land); Isaiah 13:11 (punish world for evil… arrogant cease); Revelation 19:20–21 (beast/kings/armies slain… birds gorged); Obadiah 1:16 (drink… swallow… as though never been). Verse 4: Angels of punishment abiding, preparing instruments of Satan. Cross-refs: Matthew 13:41–42 (Son of Man send angels… gather lawless… furnace of fire); Revelation 9:1–11 (locusts/torment… given power… like scorpions); 2 Peter 2:4 (angels cast to hell… chains of darkness); Jude 1:6 (angels kept in chains… judgment). Verse 5: Enoch asks angel of peace: For whom these instruments prepared? Cross-refs: (Narrative inquiry; see v6 response.) Verse 6: Prepared for kings/mighty/exalted and earth-dwellers, to destroy them thereby. Cross-refs: Isaiah 24:21–22 (punish host of heaven/kings of earth… shut in prison… after many days visited); Revelation 18:9–10 (kings who committed fornication… weep/smoke of burning); Psalm 2:10–12 (kings be wise… serve Yahuah (God) with fear… kiss Son lest perish); Jeremiah 25:33–34 (slain from one end earth to other… no lament… fall like vessel). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 53 exposes the futility of worldly power and false offerings—kings/mighty/exalted prepare their own destruction via instruments of torment, as sinners’ oppression ends in eternal banishment before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. No valley fills with bribes; lawless perish forever. Angels ready tools for the arrogant. This warns: human might crumbles, Satan’s arsenal turns on its users. Foreshadows NT judgment on oppressors (Revelation 18–19). Discern: Teachings that call out kings/mighty’s lawlessness, affirm Yahuah’s destruction of evil, and reject compromise with the exalted align. Beware exaltation of earthly power or offerings without repentance. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the valley awaits the wicked, but the faithful stand apart (Proverbs 11:4; James 5:1–6). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; destruction comes to the destroyers!

chapters.title: The Burning Valley for Kings and Mighty; Chains for Azazel’s Hosts; the Noachic Fragment

verses.text: And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.
And they brought the kings and the mighty, and began to cast them into this deep valley.
And there mine eyes saw how they made these their instruments, iron chains of immeasurable weight.
And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘For whom are these chains being prepared?’

And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (God) of Spirits commanded.

And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (God) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’ LIV. 7.-LV. 2. Noachic Fragment on the first World Judgement.
And in those days shall punishment come from Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth.
And all the waters shall be joined with the waters: that which is above the heavens is the masculine, and the water which is beneath the earth is the feminine.
And they shall destroy all who dwell on the earth and those who dwell under the ends of the heaven.
And when they have recognized their unrighteousness which they have wrought on the earth, then by these shall they perish.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 54 intensifies the judgment visions: a fiery deep valley receives kings and mighty, cast in for destruction. Iron chains of immense weight are forged for Azazel’s hosts (fallen angels/Watchers), to bind them in the abyss with rough stones covering jaws, per Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ command. Archangels (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Phanuel) seize and hurl them into the burning furnace on the great day, avenging their unrighteousness, Satan-subjection, and misleading earth’s dwellers. A Noachic fragment transitions: Yahuah (God) of Spirits unleashes upper/lower waters (masculine/feminine joined) to destroy all on earth/under heaven in the Flood-like judgment, perishing as they acknowledge their evil. This links fallen angels’ punishment to humanity’s, echoing Genesis Flood as prototype for final reckoning. Verse 1: Turned to another part; deep valley with burning fire. Cross-refs: Revelation 19:20 (beast/false prophet cast alive into lake of fire burning with brimstone); Revelation 20:10 (devil cast into lake of fire… tormented day/night); Isaiah 30:33 (Tophet ordained of old… deep and large… breath of Yahuah (God) as stream of brimstone); Daniel 7:11 (beast slain… body given to burning flame). Verse 2: Kings and mighty brought and cast into deep valley. Cross-refs: Revelation 6:15 (kings/mighty/chief captains hide… from face of Him on throne); Isaiah 24:21–22 (punish host of high ones/kings of earth… shut in prison); Psalm 2:10–12 (kings warned… serve Yahuah (God)… kiss Son lest perish in way); Jeremiah 25:33 (slain of Yahuah (God)… from one end earth to other). Verse 3: Instruments: iron chains of immeasurable weight. Cross-refs: 2 Peter 2:4 (angels that sinned… cast down to hell… chains of darkness); Jude 1:6 (angels kept not first estate… reserved in everlasting chains under darkness); Revelation 20:1–3 (angel… chain… bind dragon… cast into bottomless pit). Verse 4: Asked angel of peace: For whom chains prepared? Cross-refs: (Narrative; leads to v5 explanation.) Verse 5: Chains for hosts of Azâzêl; cast into abyss of condemnation, jaws covered with rough stones as Yahuah (God) of Spirits commanded. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 10:4–6 (bind Azazel… cast into darkness… cover face… rough/jagged rocks); Revelation 20:3 (cast into bottomless pit… shut/seal… no more deceive nations); Isaiah 24:22 (gathered as prisoners in pit… shut up many days); Leviticus 16:8–10 (scapegoat for Azazel… wilderness). Verse 6: Michael/Gabriel/Raphael/Phanuel take hold on great day, cast into burning furnace; Yahuah (God) of Spirits vengeance for unrighteousness, subject to Satan, leading astray earth’s dwellers. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:10 (devil… cast into lake… where beast/false prophet… tormented); Daniel 12:1 (Michael stand up… great time of trouble); Revelation 12:7–9 (Michael/angels war… dragon cast out); Jude 1:9 (Michael… dispute with devil… rebuke in name of Yahuah (God)). Verse 7: Punishment from Yahuah (God) of Spirits; open chambers of waters above heavens/fountains beneath earth. Cross-refs: Genesis 7:11 (windows of heaven opened… fountains great deep broken up); Genesis 8:2 (windows heaven stopped… fountains deep stopped); Psalm 148:4 (waters above heavens praise Yahuah (God)); Job 38:16 (entered springs of sea… walked in recesses deep?). Verse 8: Waters joined (above masculine, below feminine). Cross-refs: Genesis 1:6–7 (firmament divide waters… waters above/below); Proverbs 8:27–29 (set compass on face deep… established clouds above… fountains deep); Job 26:8 (binds waters in thick clouds… cloud not rent). Verse 9: Destroy all dwelling on earth/under ends of heaven. Cross-refs: Genesis 7:21–23 (all flesh died… every living… destroyed from earth); Isaiah 24:1 (Yahuah (God) empties earth… turns upside down); Zephaniah 1:2–3 (utterly consume all… man/beast/fowls/fishes). Verse 10: Recognize unrighteousness wrought on earth; by these (waters) perish. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:5–7 (wickedness great… every imagination evil… repent made man); Romans 1:18–20 (wrath revealed… suppress truth… without excuse); Revelation 16:21 (great hail… men blasphemed… plague exceedingly). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 54 reveals layered judgment—fiery valley/abyss for kings/mighty and Azazel’s hosts, bound by archangels into furnace for vengeance by Yahuah (God) of Spirits. No escape for those subject to Satan, deceiving earth. Noachic waters preview total destruction for unrighteousness acknowledgment too late. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s vengeance on fallen angels/leaders, binding deceivers, and ultimate cleansing align. Beware minimizing angelic rebellion or human complicity in Satan’s work. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the chains await the hosts, furnace the unrighteous, waters the deceived (2 Peter 2:4–9; Jude 1:6–7). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; great day brings reckoning and purity!

chapters.title: The Repentance of the Head of Days; Oath of No More Universal Destruction; Sign in Heaven; Final Judgment of Azazel and Hosts

verses.text: And after that the Head of Days repented and said: ‘In vain have I destroyed all who dwell on the earth.’

And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.’ LV. 3-LVI. 4. Final Judgement of Azazel, the Watchers and their children.

When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain because of this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith Elohim (God), Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

Ye †mighty kings† who dwell on the earth, ye shall have to behold Mine Elect One, how he sits on the throne of glory and judges Azâzêl, and all his associates, and all his hosts in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 55 reveals divine mercy after judgment: the Head of Days repents of total destruction (echoing post-Flood regret in Genesis), swearing by His great name never again to wipe out all earth’s dwellers universally. He promises a heavenly sign as eternal pledge of good faith (like rainbow covenant). Yet mercy has limits—on the day of tribulation, angels will seize the wicked; Elohim (God), Yahuah (God) of Spirits will pour chastisement/wrath. Mighty kings/earth-dwellers must witness the Elect One enthroned in glory, judging Azazel, his associates, and hosts in Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name. This balances judgment (prior chapters) with covenant mercy, foreshadowing final reckoning for fallen angels/leaders while assuring no total repeat annihilation. Verse 1: After that, Head of Days repented: ‘In vain have I destroyed all who dwell on the earth.’ Cross-refs: Genesis 6:6–7 (Yahuah (God) repented… grieved… destroy man from face); Genesis 8:21 (Yahuah (God) smelled sweet savour… not again curse ground… destroy all living); Exodus 32:14 (Yahuah (God) repented of evil… spoken); Jonah 3:10 (Elohim (God) repented… turned from fierce anger). Verse 2: Sware by great name: ‘Henceforth not do so to all on earth; set sign in heaven: pledge of good faith forever, so long as heaven above earth. According to My command.’ Cross-refs: Genesis 9:11–17 (never again destroy all flesh by waters… rainbow sign… covenant between Me/you/every living… perpetual); Isaiah 54:9–10 (waters of Noah… not overflow… mountains depart not… covenant of peace not removed); Jeremiah 33:20–21 (if covenant day/night broken… then My covenant with David broken); Ezekiel 16:60 (remember covenant… establish everlasting). Verse 3: When desire to take hold by angels on day of tribulation/pain, cause chastisement/wrath to abide, saith Elohim (God), Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Matthew 24:21 (great tribulation… not since beginning); Revelation 7:14 (great tribulation… washed robes); Jeremiah 30:7 (time of Jacob’s trouble… none like it); Isaiah 26:20–21 (hide… indignation passes… punish inhabitants for iniquity); Psalm 50:15 (call in day of trouble… deliver/glorify). Verse 4: Ye †mighty kings† on earth behold Mine Elect One: sits on throne of glory, judges Azâzêl/all associates/hosts in name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:9–14 (Ancient of Days… throne… Son of Man… everlasting dominion); Revelation 19:11–16 (Faithful/True… judges… eyes flame… name Word of God… King of kings); Revelation 20:10 (devil… cast lake fire… tormented); Isaiah 24:21–22 (punish host high/kings earth… shut pit); Matthew 25:31 (Son of Man throne glory… judge nations). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 55 shows Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ heart—regret over total destruction leads to sworn covenant mercy (heavenly sign, no repeat flood-like wipeout), yet wrath abides on unrepentant in tribulation. Elect Oneenthroned judges Azazel/hosts; kings witness inescapable reckoning. Mercy for creation, judgment for deceivers/oppressors. This echoes Genesis rainbow promise while affirming final justice. Discern: Teachings proclaiming Yahuah’s faithful covenant (sign/pledge), Elect One’s judging authority, and limits to mercy (wrath on Azazel’s) align. Beware false security in “no more destruction” without repentance. Cling to Yahuah’s name—He swears good faith forever, but mighty kings behold the throne (Hebrews 6:13–18; Revelation 20:11–15). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; sign in heaven reminds, Elect One reigns!

chapters.title: Angels of Punishment; the Valley Filled; Last Struggle of Heathen Powers against Israel

verses.text: And I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment going, and they held scourges and chains of iron and bronze.
And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘To whom are these who hold the scourges going?’
And he said unto me: ‘To their elect and beloved ones, that they may be cast into the chasm of the abyss of the valley.

And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved, And the days of their lives shall be at an end, And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned. LVI. 5-8. Last Struggle of the Heathen Powers against Yashar'el (Israel).

And in those days the angels shall return And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes: They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them, And they shall rouse them from their thrones, That they may break forth as lions from their lairs, And as hungry wolves among their flocks.
And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones, [And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway:]

But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses. And they shall begin to fight among themselves, And their right hand shall be strong against themselves, And a man shall not know his brother, Nor a son his father or his mother, Till there be no number of the corpses through their slaughter, And their punishment be not in vain.
In those days Sheol shall open its jaws, And they shall be swallowed up therein, And their destruction shall be at an end; Sheol shall devour the sinners in the presence of the elect.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 56 escalates end-time chaos: hosts of punishment angels carry iron/bronze scourges/chains toward the wicked’s “elect and beloved” (ironic twist on favored oppressors), casting them into the abyss valley—filling it as their lives/deception end forever. Angels then provoke eastern powers (Parthians/Medes/kings) to rage like lions/wolves, invading the land of His elect ones (threshing-floor/highway underfoot). Yet the righteous city blocks their horses; invaders turn fratricidal—brother against brother, son against parents—in massive slaughter, punishment effective. Sheol opens to swallow sinners before the elect’s eyes, destruction complete. This depicts divine reversal: oppressors self-destruct, elect protected amid turmoil, echoing prior valleys/chains. Verse 1: Hosts of angels of punishment going, holding scourges/chains of iron/bronze. Cross-refs: Revelation 9:3–10 (locusts with scorpion power/torment… tails like scorpions); Revelation 20:1–3 (angel with great chain… bind dragon); Psalm 149:6–9 (two-edged sword in hand… execute vengeance… chains upon kings/nobles); Nahum 3:2–3 (whips/chariots… horsemen… corpses no end). Verse 2: Asked angel of peace: To whom scourges going? Cross-refs: (Narrative inquiry; response in v3.) Verse 3: To their elect/beloved ones, cast into chasm/abyss of valley. Cross-refs: Revelation 19:20 (beast/false prophet cast alive into lake fire); Isaiah 24:22 (gathered prisoners in pit… shut up); Jeremiah 51:63–64 (Babylon sink… no more rise… recompense evil). Verse 4: Valley filled with their elect/beloved; days of lives end, leading astray no more reckoned. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:10 (devil… tormented day/night forever… no more deceive); Isaiah 65:20 (no more… sinner accursed); Psalm 37:38 (transgressors destroyed together… posterity cut off). Verse 5: Angels return east upon Parthians/Medes; stir kings to unrest, rouse from thrones like lions/wolves from lairs/flocks. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 51:20–23 (hammer… shatter nations/kings… horses/chariots); Daniel 7:5 (bear devour flesh); Revelation 16:12 (kings from east… Euphrates dried); Isaiah 13:17 (Medes… no pity silver/gold). Verse 6: Go up, tread land of His elect ones; land as threshing-floor/highway. Cross-refs: Micah 4:13 (arise/thresh… horns iron… crush peoples); Isaiah 41:15–16 (new threshing sledge… mountains chaff… wind scatter); Joel 3:13 (sickle… tread winepress… wickedness great). Verse 7: City of righteous hinders horses; fight among themselves, right hand against self; no know brother/father/mother; corpses innumerable, punishment not vain. Cross-refs: Zechariah 14:13 (great panic… hand against neighbor); Ezekiel 38:21 (call sword against Gog… every man’s sword against brother); Haggai 2:22 (overthrow throne kingdoms… destroy chariots/horses); Judges 7:22 (Midian turned sword against brother); Revelation 6:4 (take peace… slay one another). Verse 8: Sheol opens jaws, swallowed up; destruction at end; Sheol devours sinners before elect. Cross-refs: Isaiah 5:14 (Sheol enlarged… opens mouth without measure… nobility swallowed); Numbers 16:30–33 (earth opens… Korah/assembly go down alive to Sheol); Psalm 49:14 (Sheol shall feed on them… upright rule over them in morning); Revelation 20:14 (death/hell cast into lake fire… second death). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 56 shows Yahuah’s sovereign reversal—punishment angels target wicked “beloved,” abyss fills as deception ends; heathen hordes stirred to invade elect’s land but implode in self-slaughter, righteous city unbreached, Sheol devours before elect. Chaos serves divine purpose: oppressors’ might turns inward, elect witness vindication. Foreshadows NT: nations rage (Psalm 2), but Yahuah (God) laughs (v4–6); self-destruction (Zechariah 14). Discern: Teachings affirming protection of Yahuah’s elect amid global turmoil, judgment on deceivers/invaders, and Sheol’s final swallow align. Beware alliances with “mighty” that lead astray—Yahuah (God) hinders horses, turns swords inward. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the valley fills the wicked, city stands, elect behold victory (Psalm 46:5–7; Revelation 19:11–21). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; punishment not in vain!

chapters.title: The Host of Chariots; Cosmic Upheaval; End of the Second Parable

verses.text: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.

And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.
And they shall all fall down and worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits. And this is the end of the second Parable.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 57 concludes the Second Parable with a dramatic vision of upheaval: Enoch sees another host of wagons/chariots with riders coming swiftly on winds from east, west, south—creating massive noise and turmoil. Heavenly holy ones notice; earth’s pillars shake, sound echoes across heaven in one day. All fall down to worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits. This cosmic commotion signals the Parable’s end, transitioning from judgment themes (kings/mighty cast down, angels stirring nations) to final worship and order. It evokes end-time signs—earth shaken, universal acknowledgment of Yahuah (God)—as the Parables section wraps. Verse 1: After this, saw host of wagons/men riding, coming on winds from east/west to south. Cross-refs: Zechariah 6:1–8 (four chariots… winds/spirits… go forth); Revelation 7:1–3 (four angels holding winds… do not harm earth/sea/trees until seal servants); Isaiah 66:15 (Yahuah (God) comes with fire… chariots like whirlwind); Habakkuk 3:8–11 (chariots of salvation… mountains saw… earth trembled). Verse 2: Noise of wagons heard; turmoil causes holy ones from heaven to remark; pillars of earth moved; sound from one end heaven to other in one day. Cross-refs: Haggai 2:6–7 (shake heavens/earth/sea/dry land… nations shake); Hebrews 12:26–27 (voice shook earth… yet once more shake not only earth but heaven); Psalm 18:7–15 (earth shook/rocked… foundations trembled… Yahuah (God) thundered from heaven); Joel 2:10 (before Him earth quakes… heavens tremble… sun/moon darkened); Revelation 16:18 (voices/thunders/lightnings… great earthquake… cities fell). Verse 3: All fall down/worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits. End of the second Parable. Cross-refs: Philippians 2:10–11 (every knee bow… every tongue confess Jesus Christ is Lord); Revelation 5:13 (every creature… blessing/honor/glory/power to Him on throne and to Lamb forever); Isaiah 45:23 (every knee bow… every tongue swear); Zechariah 14:16 (survivors from nations… worship King Yahuah (God) yearly); Psalm 86:9 (all nations… worship… glorify Your name). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 57 seals the Second Parable with cosmic signs—chariots on winds, earth pillars shaken, universal sound/heavenly notice—culminating in all falling to worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Turmoil precedes adoration; upheaval heralds acknowledgment. This warns of coming disquiet (nations stirred, as prior) but promises Yahuah’s ultimate sovereignty—all bow. Foreshadows NT: every knee bows (Philippians 2), creation groans then worships (Romans 8:19–23; Revelation 5). Discern: Teachings that affirm Yahuah’s name exalted in chaos, universal worship inevitable, and Parables’ judgments leading to glory align. Beware downplaying signs of upheaval or denying Yahuah’s lordship. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the winds bring hosts, pillars shake, but all worship (Psalm 99:1–5; Revelation 15:3–4). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; Second Parable ends in adoration!

chapters.title: The Third Parable: The Light and Joy of the Righteous

verses.text: And I began to speak the third Parable concerning the righteous and elect.
Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect, For glorious shall be your lot.
And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy and elect shall be without number.
And they shall seek the light and find righteousness with Yahuah (God) of Spirits: There shall be peace to the righteous in the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.

And after this it shall be said to the holy in heaven That they should seek out the secrets of righteousness, The heritage of faith: For it has become bright as the sun upon earth, And the darkness is past.
And there shall be no limit to the light Which shall never cease; For the darkness shall be destroyed, And the light established for ever and ever before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 58 opens the Third Parable with a direct blessing on the righteous and elect: their lot is glorious, dwelling in unending light like the sun (righteous) and eternal life (elect). Their days are without number, seeking/finding righteousness and peace forever in Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name. Heavenly holy ones are called to seek righteousness secrets and faith heritage, now shining brightly on earth as darkness passes. Light becomes limitless and eternal before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, darkness utterly destroyed. This shifts from prior judgment-heavy Parables to hope: vindication brings perpetual light, peace, and no end to the faithful’s joy—contrasting the wicked’s perishing. Verse 1: Began to speak the third Parable concerning the righteous and elect. Cross-refs: (Structural; introduces shift to blessing, cf. Matthew 5:3–12 Beatitudes for righteous/elect). Verse 2: Blessed are ye, righteous and elect, for glorious shall be your lot. Cross-refs: Matthew 5:3–12 (blessed poor in spirit… persecuted for righteousness… great reward in heaven); 1 Peter 1:3–4 (living hope… inheritance incorruptible… reserved in heaven); Psalm 37:18 (Yahuah (God) knows days of upright… their inheritance forever). Verse 3: Righteous in light of sun; elect in light of eternal life; days unending, holy/elect without number. Cross-refs: Malachi 4:2 (Sun of Righteousness arise with healing… wings); Revelation 21:23–25 (no need sun/moon… glory of Elohim (God) lightens it… no night); Psalm 84:11 (Yahuah (God) Elohim (God) sun/shield… grace/glory); Daniel 12:3 (wise shine like brightness of firmament… stars forever); Isaiah 60:19–20 (Yahuah (God) everlasting light… no more sun set). Verse 4: Seek light/find righteousness with Yahuah (God) of Spirits; peace to righteous in name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits forever. Cross-refs: Isaiah 26:3 (perfect peace… mind stayed on You); Psalm 29:11 (Yahuah (God) give strength… bless people with peace); John 16:33 (peace in Me… overcome world); Romans 5:1 (peace with Elohim (God) through our Lord); Philippians 4:7 (peace of Elohim (God)… guard hearts/minds). Verse 5: Said to holy in heaven: seek secrets of righteousness, heritage of faith; become bright as sun on earth, darkness past. Cross-refs: Ephesians 5:8–14 (once darkness… now light in Lord… walk as children of light… arise from dead… Christ give light); Colossians 1:12–13 (inheritance of saints in light… delivered from power of darkness); 1 John 2:8 (true light… darkness passing… true light shines); Isaiah 60:1–2 (arise shine… glory risen… darkness cover earth… Yahuah (God) risen upon you). Verse 6: No limit to light, never cease; darkness destroyed, light established forever before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Revelation 22:5 (no night… need no lamp/sun… Yahuah (God) Elohim (God) give light… reign forever); Psalm 36:9 (fountain of life… in Your light see light); 1 John 1:5 (Elohim (God) is light… no darkness at all); Isaiah 60:20 (Yahuah (God) everlasting light… days of mourning ended). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 58 bursts with hope in the Third Parable—blessed righteous/elect inherit unending light, eternal days, perfect peace in Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name, darkness forever gone. Light shines bright as sun, limitless before Him. This comforts after judgment visions: persecution ends, faith heritage glows, holy seek righteousness eternally. Foreshadows NT: light of world (John 8:12), no night in new creation (Revelation 21–22). Discern: Teachings exalting Yahuah’s name for peace/light, promising glory to elect/righteous, and total end of darkness align. Beware doctrines dimming hope or denying eternal light for faithful. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the Sun rises, darkness flees, light never ceases (Malachi 4:2; Revelation 22:5). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; your lot is glorious, days without number!

chapters.title: The Secrets of Lightning and Thunder; the Spirits of the Winds

verses.text: In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgements’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as Yahuah (God) of Spirits willeth.

And there I saw the secrets of the thunder, and he showed me the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.

And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.

And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other: and the sun has a special chariot on which he ascends, and the moon likewise has her own chariot in which she travels.
And in six directions they go forth, and in six directions they return, and after them many other chariots, and they return on their paths according to their number.
And after this the winds go forth and spread over the earth, and cause the earth and all that is on the earth to shake, and the waters and all that is in the waters to shake.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 59 unveils hidden cosmic secrets shown to Enoch: lightning executes judgments as blessing or curse by Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ will; thunder’s mysteries, winds divided to blow across earth, clouds/dew sources sustaining the dusty ground. Closed chambers hold hail/winds/mist/clouds (hovering since creation’s beginning). Sun/moon chambers reveal their chariots, orbits, mutual superiority/faithfulness—no deviation, adding/taking nothing. Winds in six directions proceed/return, followed by others; they shake earth/waters/all therein. This ties natural phenomena to divine order/judgment—righteous/elect receive these revelations, contrasting wicked ignorance, affirming Yahuah’s sovereign control over creation elements used for blessing, curse, or shaking in end times. Verse 1: Secrets of lightning/lights; judgments executed (lighten for blessing/curse as Yahuah (God) of Spirits wills). Cross-refs: Job 37:2–5 (hear thunder… voice of Elohim (God)… lightning… great things we cannot comprehend); Psalm 29:3–9 (voice of Yahuah (God) over waters… breaks cedars… shakes wilderness); Revelation 4:5 (lightnings/voices/thunders from throne); Exodus 9:23–24 (thunder/hail… fire… judgment on Egypt). Verse 2: Secrets of thunder; winds divided to blow on earth; clouds/dew proceed from place, saturate dusty earth. Cross-refs: Job 38:24–27 (path for lightning/thunder… rain on land no man… satisfy desolate waste); Psalm 135:7 (makes clouds rise… lightning for rain… brings wind from storehouses); Jeremiah 10:13 (voice utters… waters in heavens… makes clouds rise… wind from treasuries); Amos 4:7 (withhold rain… rain on one city… not another). Verse 3: Closed chambers for winds/hail/mist/clouds; cloud hovers over earth from world’s beginning. Cross-refs: Job 38:22 (treasuries of snow/hail… reserved for time of trouble); Genesis 1:6–8 (firmament divide waters… above/below); Psalm 148:4 (waters above heavens praise Yahuah (God)); Proverbs 8:28 (clouds above… fountains deep fixed). Verse 4: Chambers of sun/moon; chariots ascend/travel; one superior; stately orbit; no leave/add/take; keep faith. Cross-refs: Psalm 19:4–6 (sun tabernacle… bridegroom… runs course… nothing hidden from heat); Psalm 136:7–9 (made great lights… sun rule by day… moon/stars by night); Genesis 1:14–18 (lights for signs/seasons… greater light rule day… lesser night); Jeremiah 31:35 (Yahuah (God) appoints sun/moon/stars… ordinances of heaven/earth). Verse 5: Six directions go forth/return; many other chariots follow on paths according to number. Cross-refs: (Symbolic directions; cf. Ezekiel 1:10–12 four faces/directions… move any way without turning); Revelation 7:1 (four angels at four corners earth… holding four winds); Zechariah 6:5–7 (four spirits… go forth… patrol earth). Verse 6: Winds go forth/spread; shake earth/all on it, waters/all in waters. Cross-refs: Haggai 2:6–7 (shake heavens/earth/sea/dry land); Hebrews 12:26 (voice shook earth… yet once more shake not earth only but heaven); Psalm 18:7 (earth shook/rocked… foundations trembled… because angry); Revelation 16:18 (great earthquake… cities of nations fell). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 59 reveals Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ mastery over creation’s secrets—lightning/thunder for blessing/curse, winds/chambers/clouds/sun/moon in faithful orbits, all shaking earth/waters at His will. These mysteries shown to righteous/elect highlight divine order amid judgment. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s sovereign control (blessing/curse via elements), revelations to faithful, and cosmic faithfulness align. Beware denying natural signs as judgment tools or attributing power to creation itself. Cling to Yahuah’s name—He wills lightning, divides winds, keeps sun/moon faithful; elect know secrets, wicked face shaking (Job 37:14–18; Psalm 29:1–11). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; lightnings bless the righteous, thunder declares His glory!

chapters.title: A Fragment of the Book of Noah – Quaking of Heaven; Behemoth and Leviathan; Secrets of the Elements

verses.text: In the year 500, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the life of †Enoch†. In that Parable I saw how a mighty quaking made the heaven of heavens to quake, and the host of the Most High, and the angels, a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, were disquieted with a great disquiet.
And the Head of Days sat on the throne of His glory, and the angels and the righteous stood around Him.
And a great trembling seized me, And fear took hold of me, And my loins gave way, And dissolved were my reins, And I fell upon my face.

And Michael sent another angel from among the holy ones and he raised me up, and when he had raised me up my spirit returned; for I had not been able to endure the look of this host, and the commotion and the quaking of the heaven.
And Michael said unto me: ’Why art thou disquieted with such a vision? Until this day lasted the day of His mercy; and He hath been merciful and long-suffering towards those who dwell on the earth.

And when the day, and the power, and the punishment, and the judgement come, which Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath prepared for those who worship not the righteous law, and for those who deny the righteous judgement, and for those who take His name in vain—that day is prepared, for the elect a covenant, but for sinners an inquisition.
And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster whose name is Leviathan, dwelling in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.

But the male is named Behemoth, who occupies with his breast a waste wilderness named †Dûdâîn†, east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my great-grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (God) of Spirits created.
And I besought the other angel that he should show me the might of those monsters, how they are parted on one day and become food.
And he said to me: ‘Thou son of Adam, herein thou dost seek to know what is hidden.’

And the other angel who went with me and showed me what was hidden told me what is first and last in the heaven in the height, and beneath the earth in the depth, and at the ends of the heaven, and on the foundation of the heaven, and in the chamber of the winds, and how the spirits are divided, and how the weighing in the balance is done, and how the fountains of the spirits are reckoned, each according to the power of the spirit, the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is in righteousness.
And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, and all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.

And he showed me all the secrets of the lightning and thunder, and showed me the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.

And he showed me closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world. (Note: Some editions overlap with ch. 59 elements here due to textual transmission; Charles notes this fragment’s integration.)

chapters.commentary: Chapter 60 (Noah Fragment) records a terrifying vision: massive quaking shakes heaven/angels/host of Elyon; Head of Days enthroned amid righteous/angels; Enoch trembles/falls, revived by Michael who explains mercy’s day ends, judgment comes for deniers of Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ law/judgment. Behemoth (male, east wilderness) and Leviathan (female, abyssal waters) separated, prepared as food on judgment day (eschatological banquet for righteous). Angel reveals cosmic secrets: heaven’s ends/chambers/stars/luminaries; lightning/thunder/winds divided; clouds/dew sources; closed chambers for elements since creation. This bridges mercy/judgment, monstrous chaos subdued, hidden knowledge to elect amid fear—foreshadowing final separation and Yahuah’s order. Verse 1: Year 500… mighty quaking shakes heaven of heavens/host of Most High/angels disquieted. Cross-refs: Haggai 2:6 (shake heavens/earth); Hebrews 12:26 (shake not earth only but heaven); Joel 2:10 (earth quakes… heavens tremble before Him); Revelation 6:12–14 (great earthquake… heaven departed as scroll). Verse 2: Head of Days on throne of glory; angels/righteous around Him. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:9–10 (Ancient of Days… throne… thousands minister); Revelation 5:11 (myriads… around throne); Revelation 7:9 (great multitude before throne). Verse 3–4: Trembling/fear; loins/reins dissolve; fall on face; Michael sends angel to raise; spirit returns; unable to endure host/quaking. Cross-refs: Ezekiel 1:28 (fell on face… glory of Yahuah (God)); Daniel 10:8–9 (no strength… face to ground); Revelation 1:17 (fell at feet as dead… touched… fear not). Verse 5: Michael: Why disquieted? Day of mercy lasted; merciful/long-suffering to earth-dwellers. Cross-refs: 2 Peter 3:9 (not slack… longsuffering… not willing any perish… come to repentance); Romans 2:4 (goodness/riches… leads to repentance); Exodus 34:6 (merciful/gracious… long-suffering). Verse 6: Day/power/punishment/judgment prepared by Yahuah (God) of Spirits for non-worshipers of righteous law/deniers of judgment/takers of name in vain—covenant for elect, inquisition for sinners. Cross-refs: Malachi 3:16–18 (book of remembrance… discern righteous/wicked); Romans 2:5–11 (day of wrath… tribulation/anguish on evil… glory/honor/peace on good); Hebrews 10:30 (Yahuah (God) judge His people). Verse 7–8: Two monsters parted—Leviathan (female, abysses over fountains); Behemoth (male, breast in †Dûdâîn† wilderness east of garden where elect dwell… seventh from Adam created by Yahuah (God) of Spirits). Cross-refs: Job 40:15–24 (Behemoth… eats grass… tail like cedar); Job 41:1–34 (Leviathan… no one stirs him up); Psalm 74:13–14 (broke heads of dragons… gave Leviathan as food); Isaiah 27:1 (punish Leviathan… serpent… slay dragon in sea). Verse 9: Besought angel show might of monsters—parted one day, become food. Cross-refs: Isaiah 25:6 (feast of fat things… wines… for all peoples); Revelation 19:17–18 (supper of great Elohim (God)… eat flesh of kings/mighty); Ezekiel 39:17–20 (sacrificial feast on mountains… eat flesh/drink blood of mighty). Verse 10–12: Angel: Thou seek hidden; reveals first/last in heaven/earth/ends/chambers/stars/luminaries before holy ones. Cross-refs: Job 38:4–7 (foundations of earth… morning stars sang); Psalm 148:1–6 (praise Yahuah (God)… sun/moon/stars… established forever); Revelation 4:6–8 (four living creatures… full of eyes… praise day/night). Verse 13–14: Secrets of lightning/thunder/winds divided/clouds/dew; closed chambers (hail/winds/mist/clouds) hover from beginning. Cross-refs: Job 38:22–30 (treasuries of snow/hail… path for thunderbolt… who fathers rain/dew?); Psalm 135:7 (makes clouds… lightning for rain… wind from storehouses); Genesis 1:6–8 (firmament… waters above/below). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 60 (Noah Fragment) confronts overwhelming divine majesty—quaking heaven, enthroned Head of Days, mercy’s end, judgment day for name-deniers vs. elect covenant. Behemoth/Leviathan subdued as food; cosmic secrets revealed to faithful amid fear. Discern: Teachings honoring Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ long-suffering turning to wrath, hidden knowledge for righteous, and chaos monsters’ defeat align. Beware minimizing judgment or exalting creation over Creator. Cling to Yahuah’s name—mercy lasts till day comes; elect covenant holds, monsters become banquet (Isaiah 27:1; Revelation 19:17–21). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; quaking reveals glory, secrets to the humble! The Invisible Wilderness of the Elect — Verse 8 and the Country the Nations Have Forgotten Verse 8 is the verse the whole chapter pivots on, and it is the verse translators have most consistently flattened. The King-James-era style carried into R.H. Charles renders the place where Behemoth was set as a waste wilderness. The Ethiopic word transliterated †Dûdâîn† — also written Dendayn, Dendain, Dudael in related textual streams — does not primarily mean waste in the sense of barren or empty. It carries the sense of hidden, concealed, unseen. An invisible wilderness. A land east of the garden that is not nothing — it is a real country — but it has been taken out of the sight of the fallen world. That single correction opens the passage. Behemoth was not exiled to a patch of empty dirt. Behemoth was set at the edge of an invisible wilderness where the elect and righteous dwell — where the great-grandfather of the speaker was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (God) of Spirits created. The elect dwell there. Enoch was taken up there. The garden is adjacent to it. This is not the wasteland of exile. This is the hidden country of the covenant line. Which tells you whose voice this is. Chapter 60 is one of the Noachic fragments — material the Parables absorbed from an older layer, spoken in the voice of Enoch's great-grandson Noah. Adam, Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch — the seventh from Adam is Enoch. Methuselah, Lamech, Noah — the tenth from Adam, the great-grandson of Enoch. The speaker names his great-grandfather the seventh from Adam, and the mathematical address is Noah's. This is Noah's witness woven into Enoch's book — the grandson-line record of what the pre-flood patriarch saw, and of where the pre-flood patriarch was taken. Noah of all men had reason to know. Enoch walked with Elohim (God) three hundred years, passed, and was translated — not into death but into the country east of the garden. Noah held that memory as family testimony and wrote it as a witness for the seed to come. When the fragment tells us Behemoth's wilderness is east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my great-grandfather was taken up, it is Noah pointing to the hidden country where his own great-grandfather still is. Enoch did not vanish. He was relocated. And the place of his relocation is the invisible wilderness of the elect. What Every Tradition Remembers Every people the nations have scattered into carries some memory of this place. Strip the local costume and the pattern is the same: a land set apart from the world's sight, a hidden country where a righteous people dwell, a crossing that must be made to reach it, and a return that is prophesied. The Celts carry it as Tír na nÓg, the land of the young — the otherworld to the north and west, home of a fair people who do not age, reachable only across a mist or a sea the profane cannot navigate. Avalon is the same memory in Arthurian clothing — an island hidden behind a veil where the wounded king was carried to be preserved. The Indian Vedic and Tibetan traditions carry it as Shambhala — a kingdom beyond the Himalayas, populated by a people who keep an ancient wisdom, concealed from ordinary eyes, to emerge again when the age requires them. The Hindu scriptures place Mount Meru at the center of the world, ringed by a country no unworthy traveler can reach. The Greeks remembered it as Hyperborea — beyond the north wind, a land of long life and perpetual light, inhabited by a righteous people who do not war. Even the twentieth-century polar records of Admiral Richard E. Byrd — whatever one makes of the authenticity of his alleged diary — entered the popular imagination because they named something the folklore already knew: that there is a land beyond the known poles, that a people dwell there, that the earth the fallen world maps is not the whole of the earth. The flat-earth movement of the last decade, whatever else it has gotten wrong, is pressing the same nerve — the nerve that says the cartography handed down at school is not the full picture, that there is a horizon nobody showed you, and a country beyond it that the prophets plainly named. Read generously, these are not competing revelations. They are the scattered seed's folklore — memories of the hidden country carried across continents and generations by peoples who forgot their own covenant identity. The Celts, the north Indians, the Greeks — many of them are the very scattered seed of the northern kingdom whom Yahuah (God) exiled through Assyria and dispersed among the nations until they became indistinguishable from the nations. They lost their language, their Torah, their identity. What they did not lose was the echo — the rumor of a hidden country where a righteous remnant waits, and of a return that is coming. The prophets name it plainly. The Ten Tribes, the Crossing, and the Drying of the River — 2 Esdras 13 The scattered seed did not simply vanish into the nations. A remnant of them crossed. The record is preserved in 2 Esdras 13, the apocalyptic vision also called 4 Ezra and carried in the Baruchan stream of literature: “Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Shalmaneser the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land. But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep their statutes, which they had not kept in their own land. And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow passages of the river. For the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over. For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arzareth. Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come, the Most High shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest thou the multitude with peace.” — 2 Esdras 13:40–47 Read that again slowly. The ten tribes Yahuah (God) exiled through Assyria did not stay scattered among the heathen. A remnant of them took counsel, left the nations, and went forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt, that they might there keep the statutes they had not kept in their own land. They crossed the Euphrates — the great river — by a miracle. The Most High held still the flood until they had passed. They travelled a year and a half into a region called Arzareth — the land of another — and they have dwelt there since, keeping the covenant. This is the invisible wilderness as Noah's great-grandson wrote it. East of the garden. Hidden from the sight of the fallen world. Inhabited by a people who crossed over to keep the commandments. A country the nations do not map. And the same passage names the last-days reversal: when they shall begin to come, the Most High shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through. The great river that was dried up for them to cross into the hidden country will be dried up again for them to cross back. The gathering is a re-crossing. The hidden country empties, and the returning host comes out. Jeremiah 16:13–16 — Gathered from the North and from All Nations The prophet Jeremiah names the double gathering — from the hidden country of the north and from the nations of the scattering — in the same breath. The passage opens with the exile: “Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.” — Jeremiah 16:13 The scattering is into a land you do not know. Not a forgotten land — an unknown one. And then the reversal: “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (God), that it shall no more be said, Yahuah (God) liveth, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt; But, Yahuah (God) liveth, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers. Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith Yahuah (God), and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.” — Jeremiah 16:14–16 Two gatherings, one reversal. From the land of the north — the invisible wilderness of Arzareth, the hidden country east of the garden — Yahuah (God) brings the ones who crossed. And from all the lands whither he had driven them — the nations of the scattering — Yahuah (God) brings the ones who remained dispersed, the fishers and the hunters sent out for them to every mountain and every hill. Two streams. One return. The Exodus from Egypt will be eclipsed not by the memory of the Red Sea but by the memory of this gathering — from the north, and from the nations. That is the prophetic weight Jeremiah is laying down. Isaiah 14 — The Sides of the North The adversary himself tells you where the congregation of Yahuah (God) assembles. The boast recorded in Isaiah 14 is the boast of a being who knows exactly where the throne of the covenant people is set and covets that address: “For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.” — Isaiah 14:13–14 The mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north. Adversary grammar — but the address is real. There is a mount. There is a congregation. It is in the sides of the north. It is the place the fallen one wanted to sit on — the place of the covenant assembly. The invisible wilderness of the elect, east of the garden, in the sides of the north. Noah's Parables-fragment, the prophet Jeremiah, the scribe of 2 Esdras, and the envious boast of ha-Satan are all naming the same geography. The elect have a country, and the adversary knows exactly where it is. The Feast of Tabernacles — Temporary Dwelling Before the Land And when the gathering begins, where are the scattered brought? Not directly into the land of promise. First into a temporary dwelling — a booth, a wilderness camp, a Feast of Tabernacles spread across the hidden country of the sifting. The feast itself was given to memorialize the very pattern: “Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths: That your generations may know that I made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah (God) your Elohim (God).” — Leviticus 23:42–43 The annual Feast of Tabernacles is the rehearsal. The sukkah is the memory of the wilderness dwelling — the temporary shelter that marked the people while they were between. Between Egypt and the land. Between the crossing and the inheritance. The gathering of the last days is the Feast of Tabernacles fulfilled in scale. The hidden country is where the booths go up. The elect dwell in the invisible wilderness as a people in tabernacles — not yet in the land, but no longer in the nations. The in-between place. The sifting place. The camp of the feast. Ezekiel 20:34–38 — The Wilderness of the People and the Rod of the Covenant Ezekiel names the location and the purpose with more precision than any prophet: “And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out. And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face. Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith Yahuah (God) Elohim (God). And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).” — Ezekiel 20:34–38 The gathering from the nations is not to the land first.
