It is to the wilderness of the people — and the next sentence names what happens there. I will plead with you face to face. Confrontation. Reckoning. The plea Egypt's generation received in the first wilderness is the plea the scattering's returning sheep will receive in the second wilderness. I will cause you to pass under the rod. The rod is the shepherd's instrument that numbers the sheep — one by one, under the staff, counted, separated, examined. The rod is the sifting tool. I will purge out from among you the rebels. Those who pass under the rod and stand are brought into the bond of the covenant. Those who do not stand are held back. They do not enter the land. The invisible wilderness is the sifting wilderness. Not a reward for having returned. A reckoning before the land is entered. The Feast of Tabernacles temporary dwelling is the duration of the plea — face to face, rod by rod, name by name. And the new covenant the prophet promised — the Torah written on the heart by the Spirit — is sealed there. Not in a church building. Not on a seminary syllabus. In the wilderness of the people, after the crossing, under the rod. “But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (God), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.” — Jeremiah 31:33 The Kingdom of Priests Enters the Land What emerges from that sifting is what Yahuah (God) told Moses on Sinai at the first giving of the covenant: “Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).” — Exodus 19:5–6 A kingdom of priests. Not a nation among nations. A people whose national office is priesthood — whose civic life is the service of the Most High, whose every trade and field and household is an altar. The Sinai call was the blueprint. The flesh-generation Sinai gathered could not keep it. The scattering followed. The invisible wilderness preserved a remnant in the hidden country. The gathering recovers the scattered from the nations. The rod sifts the gathered. And the ones who pass under the rod enter the land of promise as the kingdom of priests Sinai named them to be — finally, fully, under the new covenant that put the Torah in the inward parts. This is the arc the Parables are pointing at, and verse 8 of chapter 60 is one of its brightest markers. Noah, writing in the pre-flood memory of where his own great-grandfather was taken, shows the reader that the land of the elect is not gone. It is hidden. It is east of the garden. It is in the sides of the north. It is Arzareth. It is the wilderness of the people. It is the invisible wilderness where the elect and righteous dwell. And a generation is coming when the great river will be dried up a second time, and the hidden country will empty, and the nations will give up their own, and the sifting wilderness will fill with the twelve tribes come home, and the rod will pass, and the covenant will be sealed in the heart, and the land of promise will be entered by a kingdom of priests — the one Sinai named and the prophets have been watching for ever since. Cross-references: Genesis 2:8 (Yahuah planted a garden eastward in Eden); Genesis 3:24 (cherubim placed at the east of the garden to guard the way of the tree of life); Genesis 5:24 (Enoch walked with Elohim and he was not, for Elohim took him); Hebrews 11:5 (by faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death); 2 Kings 17:6 (Assyria carried Yashar'el away); Hosea 1:9–10 (Lo-Ammi, not my people; in the place where it was said they are not my people, there shall they be called sons of the living Elohim); Isaiah 11:11–12 (the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people; he shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah); Isaiah 35:1–8 (the wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; a highway shall be there); Ezekiel 37:15–28 (two sticks, Yahudah and Yosef, one in the hand of Yahuah); Zechariah 10:8–12 (I will hiss for them, and gather them, and bring them again out of the land of Egypt and out of Assyria); Zechariah 14:16–19 (all the nations that came up against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to keep the Feast of Tabernacles); Micah 7:14–15 (feed thy people with thy rod; according to the days of thy coming out of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things); Exodus 19:5–6 (kingdom of priests); Revelation 1:6, 5:10 (kings and priests unto our Elohim, and we shall reign on the earth).

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – The Elect One on the Throne; Summoning of Kings and Mighty; Resurrection and Praise

verses.text: And I saw in those days how long cords were given to those angels, and they took to themselves wings and flew, and they went towards the north.
And I asked the angel, saying unto him: ‘Why have those (angels) taken these cords and gone off?’ And he said unto me: ‘They have gone to measure.’

And the angel who went with me said unto me: ‘These shall bring the measures of the righteous, And the ropes of the righteous to the righteous, That they may stay themselves on the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.
The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect, And those are the measures which shall be given to faith And which shall strengthen righteousness.

And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.
And all who dwell above in the heaven received a command, And power and one voice and one might and one command were given them.
And that One (with) the command went forth, And He said: ‘These are the measures which shall be given to the righteous and elect And which shall strengthen them before the Head of Days.’
And the Head of Days placed the Elect One on the throne of His glory; And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.

And when he shall lift up his countenance To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless, And glorify and extol and laud the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Chosen One, and the other powers on the earth, and over the water, on that day.

And they shall raise one voice and bless and glorify and extol and praise the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits in faith and in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: ‘Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever.’
And that Angel of Peace who went with me said to me: ‘These are the secrets which thou hast seen.’

chapters.commentary: Chapter 61 advances the Third Parable’s vision of vindication: angels with cords measure the righteous/elect, strengthening them to stay on Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name forever. Measures reveal earth’s secrets, resurrecting those destroyed (by desert/beasts/sea) to stand on the Elect One’s day—no destruction before Yahuah (God). Heavenly host receives unified command/power/voice; the Elect One is placed by the Head of Days on the throne of glory to judge holy works/deeds in balance. When He lifts His face to judge secret ways/path in Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ righteous name, all speak with one voice to bless/glorify/extol His name. He summons all heavenly hosts (Cherubim/Seraphim/Ophanim/angels of power/principalities/Chosen One/other powers) to raise one voice of blessing in every spirit (faith/wisdom/patience/mercy/judgment/peace/goodness)—eternal praise to Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Angel of Peace confirms: these are the secrets seen. Verse 1–2: Angels given long cords, take wings, fly north; asked why—angel: to measure. Cross-refs: Zechariah 2:1–5 (man with measuring line… measure Jerusalem); Revelation 11:1–2 (reed like rod… measure temple/court); Ezekiel 40:3–5 (man with measuring reed… measure temple). Verse 3–4: Bring measures/ropes to righteous; stay on name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits forever; elect dwell with elect; measures to faith/strengthen righteousness. Cross-refs: Psalm 125:1 (they that trust in Yahuah (God)… like mount Zion… not moved forever); Isaiah 26:4 (trust in Yahuah (God) forever… everlasting strength); Hebrews 11:1 (faith substance of things hoped… evidence unseen). Verse 5: Measures reveal secrets of depths/earth; destroyed by desert/beasts/sea return/stand on day of Elect One; none destroyed before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:13 (sea gave up dead… death/hell gave up dead… judged); Hosea 13:14 (ransom from power of Sheol… redeem from death); Ezekiel 37:12–14 (open graves… bring up from graves… put My Spirit in you); 1 Corinthians 15:51–54 (dead raised incorruptible… death swallowed in victory). Verse 6–7: All above in heaven receive command/power/voice/might; One with command: measures to righteous/elect, strengthen before Head of Days. Cross-refs: Revelation 5:11–12 (myriads… saying with loud voice… worthy is Lamb); Psalm 103:20–21 (angels… do His commandments… hosts… ministers). Verse 8: Head of Days places Elect One on throne of glory; judges works of holy in heaven, weighs deeds in balance. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:13–14 (Son of Man… dominion… throne); Matthew 25:31 (Son of Man throne of glory… judge nations); Revelation 20:12 (books opened… judged according to works… book of life). Verse 9: Lifts countenance to judge secret ways/path by name/way of righteous judgment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits; all speak one voice: bless/glorify/extol/laud name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Hebrews 4:13 (all things naked/open to eyes of Him… give account); Psalm 96:13 (judge world in righteousness… peoples in truth); Philippians 2:10–11 (every knee bow… confess Jesus Christ Lord to glory of God). Verse 10–11: Summons all hosts—heaven/holy ones/Elohim (God)/Cherubim/Seraphim/Ophanim/angels of power/principalities/Chosen One/other powers on earth/water; raise one voice: bless/glorify/extol/praise name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits in faith/wisdom/patience/mercy/judgment/peace/goodness; all say: Blessed is He… name blessed forever. Cross-refs: Revelation 5:13 (every creature… blessing/honor/glory/power to Him on throne and to Lamb forever); Revelation 7:9–12 (great multitude… salvation to our Elohim (God)… angels… saying Amen… blessing/glory/wisdom/thanksgiving/honor/power/might to Elohim (God) forever); Psalm 145:21 (let all flesh bless holy name forever); Isaiah 6:2–3 (Seraphim… Holy holy holy is Yahuah (God) of hosts). Verse 12: Angel of Peace: These are the secrets thou hast seen. Cross-refs: (Closing confirmation; cf. Daniel 12:4,9 seal book till time of end; Revelation 10:4,7 mysteries finished). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 61 exalts the Elect One enthroned by Head of Days—measuring/strengthening righteous/elect to stand on His name, resurrecting destroyed ones, judging secrets/works in balance. All heaven/earth powers summoned to one-voice eternal praise of Yahuah (God) of Spirits in every godly spirit. No destruction for faithful; mercy’s measures reveal secrets for vindication. This climaxes hope: judgment seat brings universal blessing to Yahuah’s name. Discern: Teachings centering Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name in praise, Elect One’s judging throne, resurrection of righteous, and unified worship align. Beware divisions in praise or denial of secret revelations to elect. Cling to Yahuah’s name—cords measure faith, throne judges righteously, all glorify forever (Revelation 5:9–14; Psalm 145:1–21). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; measures strengthen, secrets unfold, praise never ends!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Judgment of Kings and Mighty; Terror before the Elect One; Salvation of the Righteous

verses.text: And thus the Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, And seated him on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the works of the holy in heaven above, And weigh their deeds in the balance.

And when he shall lift up his face To judge their secret ways by the word of the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And their path by the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, Then shall they all speak with one voice, And bless and glorify and extol and laud the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, And the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophanim, And all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, And the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth, and over the water, On that day.

And they shall raise one voice And bless and glorify and extol and praise the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, In faith and in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, And of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, And in the spirit of judgement and of peace, And in the spirit of goodness, And shall all say with one voice: ‘Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever.’

And that Angel of Peace who went with me said to me: ‘These are the secrets which thou hast seen.’ (Note: The above verses 1–5 appear in some editions as a continuation or slight repetition from ch. 61 for emphasis; Charles places the core new content starting here.)

And the Yahuah (God) of Spirits seated the Elect One on the throne of His glory, And he shall judge all the secret things, And no one shall be able to utter a lying word in his presence; For he is the Chosen One before Yahuah (God) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
And the Yahuah (God) of Spirits said: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

And he said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.’

And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.
And he shall humble the countenance of the strong, And shall abase the pride of the mighty, And shall make the earth shake, And shall lay low the inhabitants thereof, And shall not be ashamed.

And the countenance of the strong shall be covered with shame, And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 62 intensifies the climax of judgment in the Third Parable: the Elect One / Chosen One / Son of Man is seated by Yahuah (God) of Spirits on the throne of glory to judge secret things—no lie can stand before Him, as chosen according to Yahuah’s good pleasure. Righteousness abides with Him eternally. He reveals hidden treasures, raises/humbles kings/mighty/powerful from thrones, loosens reins, breaks sinners’ teeth, casts them down for not praising Yahuah (God) or acknowledging His gift of kingdom. He abases pride, shakes earth, lays low inhabitants; strong covered in shame, dwell in darkness, bed of worms, no hope of rising—because they deny Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ name. Heavenly hosts praise in unified voice (echoing ch. 61). This chapter warns oppressors: denial of Yahuah’s name brings irreversible shame/darkness; righteous find vindication through the Elect One. Verse 6: Yahuah (God) of Spirits seats Elect One on throne; judges secret things; no lying word before Him; Chosen Oneaccording to good pleasure. Cross-refs: Hebrews 4:13 (all things open to Him… account given); John 5:22,27 (Father judges no man… Son judges… authority as Son of Man); Revelation 19:11 (Faithful/True… judges in righteousness). Verse 7: Son of Man born unto righteousness; righteousness abides; Head of Days’ righteousness forsakes not. Cross-refs: Isaiah 11:4–5 (judge with righteousness… girdle of faithfulness); Psalm 45:7 (love righteousness… anointed with oil of gladness); Hebrews 1:8–9 (throne forever… loved righteousness… anointed). Verse 8: Son of Man with righteousness; reveals hidden treasures; Yahuah (God) of Spirits chose him; pre-eminence in uprightness forever. Cross-refs: Colossians 2:3 (in Him hidden all treasures of wisdom/knowledge); Isaiah 42:1 (Behold My Servant… chosen… uphold); Matthew 12:18 (Servant… chosen… well pleased). Verse 9–10: Raises kings/mighty from seats/thrones; loosens reins, breaks teeth of sinners; puts down kings/kingdoms for no praise/acknowledgment of Yahuah (God). Cross-refs: Psalm 2:10–12 (kings… serve Yahuah (God) with fear… kiss Son lest angry); Revelation 6:15–17 (kings/mighty hide from throne/wrath of Lamb); Isaiah 2:10–17 (lofty humbled… day of Yahuah (God)). Verse 11–12: Humbles strong/pride; shakes earth/lays low inhabitants; strong in shame/darkness/worms bed; no hope rising—for no extolling name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Psalm 49:16–20 (fear not rich… no glory in death… like beasts perish); Isaiah 14:9–11 (Sheol stirs… worms cover… no more rise); Revelation 20:12–15 (judged by works… lake of fire… second death); Job 17:13–16 (Sheol my house… worms my hope… descend to bars of pit). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 62 unveils the Elect One / Son of Man enthroned—chosen by Yahuah (God) of Spirits, revealing secrets, judging secrets without lie, humbling kings/mighty for denying His name. No praise/acknowledgment brings shame, darkness, worms, hopeless beds. Contrast: righteous strengthened (prior measures), heavenly praise unified. This warns power structures: kingdoms temporary, denial fatal. Foreshadows NT Son of Man coming in glory (Matthew 25:31; Revelation 19:11–16). Discern: Teachings exalting Yahuah’s name through Elect One, calling kings to humble acknowledgment, and promising shame to deniers align. Beware exalting human thrones over Yahuah’s. Cling to Yahuah’s name—the Chosen One judges, kings fall, righteous stand (Psalm 2:10–12; Philippians 2:9–11). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; throne of glory vindicates, darkness claims the proud!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Confession and Regret of the Kings and Mighty

verses.text: In those days shall the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who possess the earth Be summoned, And they shall be made to stand before the Elect One on that day of judgement.
And the Head of Days shall seat him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness is poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays the sinners.

And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down on their faces before him and worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And shall petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
Nevertheless that Yahuah (God) of Spirits will so press them That they shall hastily go forth from His presence, And their faces shall be filled with shame, And darkness shall be their dwelling.
And the Elect One shall stand up and judge them, And shall weigh their deeds in the balance, And their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
And the Son of Adam shall cause the sinners to be driven from the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

In those days the kings and the mighty who possess the earth Shall be seized with great terror, And shall be seized with pain like a woman in travail, Who in her travail finds it hard to bring forth the son from her womb.

And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And their countenance shall fall, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.
And the Yahuah (God) of Spirits shall drive them from the face of the earth, And they shall be driven from the face of the earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 63 portrays the climactic terror and confession of the kings, mighty, exalted, and earth-rulers before the enthroned Elect One / Son of Man on judgment day. The Head of Days seats Him with the spirit of righteousness; His word slays sinners. The powerful fall on their faces, worship, hope in the Son of Man, and beg mercy—yet Yahuah (God) of Spirits presses them out in shame and darkness. The Elect One judges their deeds/secret ways by Yahuah’s name; sinners driven from earth, deceivers removed. Kings/mighty gripped by birth-pain terror, faces fallen in horror at the Son of Man on glory’s throne. Yahuah (God) of Spirits drives them out—perishing eternally. This chapter exposes false power: denial of Yahuah’s name leads to irreversible shame, pain, expulsion; no mercy avails when judgment arrives. Contrast with righteous vindication (prior chapters). Verse 1: Kings/mighty/exalted/earth-possessors summoned; stand before Elect One on judgment day. Cross-refs: Revelation 6:15–17 (kings/mighty/chief captains… hide from face of Him on throne… wrath of Lamb); Psalm 2:10–12 (kings… be wise… serve Yahuah (God) with fear… kiss Son lest perish); Matthew 25:31–32 (Son of Man throne… all nations gathered before Him). Verse 2: Head of Days seats Him on throne of glory; spirit of righteousness poured; word of mouth slays sinners. Cross-refs: Isaiah 11:4 (smite earth with rod of mouth… slay wicked with breath of lips); Revelation 19:15 (sword from mouth… smite nations); 2 Thessalonians 2:8 (Lord consume with spirit of mouth… brightness of coming). Verse 3: All kings/mighty/exalted/rulers fall on faces, worship, hope in Son of Man, petition/supplicate mercy. Cross-refs: Philippians 2:10–11 (every knee bow… confess Jesus Christ Lord); Isaiah 45:23 (every knee bow… every tongue swear); Revelation 1:7 (every eye see Him… all kindreds wail). Verse 4: Yahuah (God) of Spirits presses them out hastily; faces filled with shame; darkness their dwelling. Cross-refs: Isaiah 2:10 (enter rock… hide dust… terror of Yahuah (God)); Psalm 34:5 (look to Him… faces not ashamed); Revelation 6:16 (hide… from face of Him… wrath). Verse 5: Elect One stands, judges them; weighs deeds in balance; secret ways by word of name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Daniel 5:27 (weighed in balances… found wanting); Revelation 20:12 (books opened… judged by works); Romans 2:6–11 (render to every man according to deeds). Verse 6: Son of Man drives sinners/deceivers from earth’s face. Cross-refs: Psalm 37:38 (transgressors destroyed… posterity cut off); Isaiah 13:11 (punish world for evil… arrogant cease); Revelation 19:20–21 (beast/kings/armies cast into lake… rest slain). Verse 7–8: Kings/mighty seized with great terror/pain like woman in travail; look on one another terrified; countenance falls; pain seizes when see Son of Man on throne of glory. Cross-refs: Isaiah 13:8 (pangs/sorrows… pain as woman in travail… amazed one at another); Jeremiah 30:6 (ask… why faces turned pale… pain like woman in travail?); Micah 4:9–10 (writhe… travail… come to birth); Revelation 6:15–17 (kings… hide… great day of wrath come… who stand?). Verse 9: Yahuah (God) of Spirits drives them from earth’s face; perish forever and ever. Cross-refs: Psalm 37:9–10 (evildoers cut off… yet a little while… wicked not be); Obadiah 1:16 (drink… swallow… as though never been); Revelation 20:10 (tormented day/night forever); Daniel 12:2 (some to everlasting contempt). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 63 exposes the end of arrogant power—kings/mighty summoned, fall in worship/plea before Elect One / Son of Man, yet driven out in shame/darkness by Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Their terror like labor pains at throne vision; no mercy, only eternal perishing for denying His name. Contrast: righteous strengthened (prior measures), heavenly praise. This warns: thrones temporary, denial fatal, late confession useless. Foreshadows NT: every knee bows too late for some (Philippians 2:10–11; Revelation 6:15–17). Discern: Teachings calling rulers to early honor Yahuah’s name, affirming Elect One’s judgment, and warning irreversible shame align. Beware exalting earthly might over Yahuah (God). Cling to Yahuah’s name—Chosen One judges, kings wail, sinners driven out (Psalm 2:10–12; Isaiah 2:10–21). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; throne brings terror to proud, glory to faithful!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – The Fallen Watchers and Their Chiefs

verses.text: And other forms I saw in that place of judgment: Many forms of flaming fire, And their form was as men, And they executed the punishment of the angels.
And I saw there the spirits of the sinners and blasphemers, And of those who work wickedness, And they made their habitation with the spirits of the fallen angels.
And in that place I saw the spirits of the fallen angels who led astray, And they were bound there until the day of their judgment.
And I saw there the spirits of the giants who were begotten by the fallen angels, And they were bound there until the day of their judgment.
And I asked the angel who showed me the secret things: ‘Who are these spirits of the fallen angels?’

And he said unto me: ‘These are the chiefs of the two hundred angels who went down in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, And they taught mankind sin, And led them astray, And they were bound by Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the valleys of the earth Until the day of consummation, The great judgement in which they shall be judged.’

chapters.commentary: Chapter 64 briefly shifts to the judgment place, revealing flaming fire forms (punishing angels) executing sentence on sinners/blasphemers, whose spirits dwell with fallen angels. The spirits of the fallen Watchers (who led astray) and their giant offspring are bound until final judgment day. The angel explains: these are the chiefs of the 200 angels who descended in Jared’s days on Mount Hermon (cf. ch. 6–7), taught sin, misled humanity, and were bound by Yahuah (God) of Spirits in earth’s valleys until consummation and great judgment. This ties back to the Watchers’ origin story, reinforcing that no sin escapes—fallen angels/giants/sinners all await irreversible reckoning before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Verse 1: Other forms in judgment place: many flaming fire forms as men, executing punishment of angels. Cross-refs: Revelation 9:1–11 (angel with key to bottomless pit… locusts/scorpions torment… given power as scorpions); Psalm 104:4 (makes angels spirits… ministers flaming fire); Hebrews 1:7 (angels spirits… ministers flame of fire). Verse 2: Spirits of sinners/blasphemers/workers of wickedness; habitation with spirits of fallen angels. Cross-refs: 2 Peter 2:4–5 (angels that sinned… cast down to hell… chains of darkness… reserved unto judgment); Jude 1:6 (angels kept not first estate… everlasting chains under darkness… judgment); Revelation 20:13–14 (death/hell gave up dead… judged… death/hell cast into lake of fire). Verse 3: Spirits of fallen angels who led astray; bound until day of judgment. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 10:4–6 (bind Azazel… cast into darkness… jagged rocks… until day of great judgment); Revelation 20:1–3 (angel… chain… bind dragon… cast into bottomless pit… no more deceive until thousand years fulfilled). Verse 4: Spirits of giants begotten by fallen angels; bound until day of judgment. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:4 (giants in earth… sons of Elohim (God) came in to daughters of men… mighty men of renown); Numbers 13:33 (saw giants… sons of Anak… we were in our sight as grasshoppers); Wisdom 14:6 (proud giants perished… hope of world preserved in ark); Jude 1:6 (cf. context of fallen angels/giants tradition). Verse 5: Asked angel showing secret things: Who are these spirits of fallen angels? Cross-refs: (Narrative inquiry; leads to v6 explanation.) Verse 6: Chiefs of 200 angels who descended in Jared’s days on Mount Hermon; taught sin, led astray; bound by Yahuah (God) of Spirits in valleys of earth until day of consummation/great judgment. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 6:1–6 (sons of heaven… descended on summit of Hermon… bound themselves by mutual imprecations… chiefs Semjâzâ/Azâzêl/etc.); Genesis 6:1–4 (sons of Elohim (God)… took wives… days of Jared implied); Deuteronomy 3:8–9 (Hermon called Sirion by Sidonians… Senir by Amorites—location tie); 2 Peter 2:4–9 (angels sinned… cast to hell… Noah preached righteousness… reserved unto judgment). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 64 reminds of the root of evil—the 200 fallen Watchers/chiefs who descended on Hermon, taught sin, begot giants, led humanity astray, now bound by Yahuah (God) of Spirits in earth’s valleys until great judgment/consummation. Sinners/blasphemers dwell with their spirits; flaming angels execute punishment. Nothing hidden—fallen angels/giants/sinners all face the day of reckoning. This warns: deception’s origin judged, no escape for leaders of astray. Foreshadows NT: angels in chains (2 Peter 2; Jude 6), final judgment (Revelation 20). Discern: Teachings acknowledging Watchers’ sin/origin of giants/corruption, affirming Yahuah’s binding until judgment, and calling to reject taught wickedness align. Beware minimizing angelic rebellion or human complicity. Cling to Yahuah’s name—He binds deceivers in valleys, flaming fire punishes, great day consummates (Jude 1:6; Revelation 20:10). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; bound spirits await, judgment comes!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Noah’s Revelation of Coming Judgment

verses.text: And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down, And its destruction was nigh.
And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, And cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: And Noah said three times with an embittered voice: Hear me, hear me, hear me.
And he said unto him: Tell me what is this thing that is falling upon the earth That the earth is so tired and shaken? May it not be on my account? Shall I be destroyed with it?
And thereupon there was a great commotion on the earth, And a voice was heard from heaven, And he fell on his face.
And Enoch his grandfather came and stood by him, And said unto him: Why hast thou cried to me with a bitter cry and weeping?
And from that time forward he did not cease to speak to the children of men, And to warn them of the coming judgment.
And these are the words which he spake to Noah: ‘In the generation of my father Jared Yahuah (God) of Spirits called me And showed me the secret things which are in heaven and on earth.
And now I tell thee, my son Noah, All these things which I have seen and heard Shall come upon the earth in the last days.
And behold, the angels who descended from heaven Have taught mankind sin, And have led them astray, And have corrupted the earth.
And the spirits of the giants shall rise up against them, And they shall destroy the children of men.
But the Most High shall send His punishment Upon the sinners and upon the fallen angels, And upon their children.
And the earth shall be cleansed from all corruption, And from all unrighteousness, And from all sin, And from all iniquity.
And all the children of men shall become righteous, And all shall worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And shall praise Him for ever and ever.
And the righteous shall be preserved, And the elect shall dwell with them, And they shall not be destroyed.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 65 (Noah Fragment) records Noah’s distress at the earth’s sinking/corruption and impending destruction, crying out to Enoch for understanding—fearing personal involvement. A great commotion and heavenly voice ensue; Enoch appears, comforts, and reveals the secrets shown to him in Jared’s generation: fallen angels taught sin, corrupted earth, begot giants whose spirits rise to destroy. Yet Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Most High will send punishment on sinners, fallen angels, and their offspring. Earth cleansed from all corruption/unrighteousness/sin/iniquity; humanity becomes righteous, worships/praises Yahuah (God) of Spirits forever. Righteous/elect preserved, undestroyed. This echoes Genesis Flood as prototype for final eschatological cleansing—judgment on corruption, preservation of faithful, universal righteous worship. Verse 1: Noah saw earth sunk; destruction nigh. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:11–13 (earth filled with violence… Elohim (God) said… end of all flesh come before Me); Isaiah 24:19–20 (earth utterly broken… reels like drunkard… falls never rise again); Revelation 16:18–20 (great earthquake… islands fled… mountains not found). Verse 2–3: Noah arose to ends of earth, cried aloud to Enoch three times bitterly: Hear me; what falling on earth… tired/shaken? On my account? Destroyed with it? Cross-refs: Genesis 6:9 (Noah just/perfect… walked with Elohim (God)); 2 Peter 2:5 (Noah preacher of righteousness… preserved); Habakkuk 1:2–4 (cry violence… law slacked… wicked surround righteous). Verse 4: Great commotion on earth; voice from heaven; Noah fell on face. Cross-refs: Ezekiel 1:28 (glory of Yahuah (God)… fell on face); Revelation 1:17 (fell at feet as dead); Daniel 10:8–9 (no strength remained… face to ground). Verse 5: Enoch stood by, asked: Why cried with bitter cry/weeping? Cross-refs: (Narrative comfort; Enoch as revealer, cf. 1 Enoch 12–16 intercession role). Verse 6: Enoch ceased not to speak/warn children of men of coming judgment. Cross-refs: 2 Peter 2:5 (Noah… preacher of righteousness); Jude 1:14–15 (Enoch prophesied… Yahuah (God) comes with ten thousands holy ones… convict ungodly); Acts 17:30–31 (commands all repent… day appointed… judge world). Verse 7: In Jared’s generation Yahuah (God) of Spirits called Enoch, showed secret things in heaven/earth. Cross-refs: Genesis 5:24 (Enoch walked with Elohim (God)… not… Elohim (God) took him); Hebrews 11:5 (Enoch translated… pleased Elohim (God)… testimony… pleased Him); Jude 1:14 (Enoch seventh from Adam… prophesied). Verse 8–9: These things come on earth in last days; angels descended taught sin/led astray/corrupted earth. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:1–4 (sons of Elohim (God)… took wives… earth filled with violence); 1 Enoch 6–8 (descent… taught enchantments/metals/weapons… corruption); Revelation 12:9 (dragon… deceives whole world). Verse 10: Spirits of giants rise against men, destroy children of men. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:4 (giants… mighty men… renown); Numbers 13:33 (giants… we grasshoppers); Wisdom 14:6 (giants’ pride perished); Baruch 3:26–28 (giants famous… perished for lack of wisdom). Verse 11: Most High sends punishment on sinners/fallen angels/their children. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 10:1–15 (punish Watchers/giants… bind… great judgment); Revelation 20:10 (devil… tormented forever); Jude 1:6 (angels… chains… judgment of great day). Verse 12: Earth cleansed from corruption/unrighteousness/sin/iniquity. Cross-refs: Isaiah 24:4–6 (earth mourns… defiled under inhabitants… curse devoured); Revelation 21:1 (new heaven/new earth… first passed away); 2 Peter 3:10–13 (day of Elohim (God)… heavens pass… elements melt… new heavens/earth righteousness dwells). Verse 13: All children of men become righteous; all worship Yahuah (God) of Spirits, praise forever. Cross-refs: Isaiah 66:23 (all flesh come worship before Me… from new moon to new moon); Zechariah 14:16 (nations… worship King Yahuah (God)); Revelation 15:4 (all nations come/worship… judgments manifested); Philippians 2:10–11 (every knee bow… confess to glory of Elohim (God)). Verse 14: Righteous preserved; elect dwell with them; not destroyed. Cross-refs: Psalm 37:29 (righteous inherit land… dwell forever); Isaiah 65:17–25 (new heavens/earth… rejoice… no more weeping… elect inherit); Revelation 21:3–4 (Elohim (God) dwells with men… no more death/sorrow). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 65 (Noah Fragment) shows Noah’s anguish at corruption’s near-end, Enoch revealing: fallen angels’ sin/teaching/corruption/giants’ spirits lead to destruction, but Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Most Highpunishes all evil, cleanses earth, makes humanity righteous, brings eternal worship/praise to His name. Righteous/elect preserved undestroyed. This prototypes final judgment after Flood—corruption ends, praise begins. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s cleansing of sin (angels/giants/human), preservation of elect, and universal righteous worship of His name align. Beware ignoring angelic corruption’s role or downplaying final cleansing. Cling to Yahuah’s name—earth shaken, corruption purged, righteous dwell forever in praise (Isaiah 65:17–25; Revelation 21:1–4). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; judgment purifies, worship endures!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Binding of the Fallen Angels; Final Cleansing

verses.text: And after this he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and release the powers of the waters upon the earth.
And the angel who went with me showed me the measure of the waters, And how they are measured, And how they are divided, And how they are weighed, And how they are reckoned.
And he showed me the measure of the fire, And how it is measured, And how it is divided, And how it is weighed, And how it is reckoned.
And he showed me the angels who are over the powers of the waters, And who release them upon the earth.

And the angel who went with me said unto me: ‘These are the angels who are over the powers of the waters, And they shall release them upon the sinners and upon the ungodly, And upon those who have led the world astray.’
And they shall be bound in the valleys of the earth Until the day of their judgment, The great day of consummation.
And in those days the punishment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits shall come upon them, And they shall be driven from the face of the earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.
And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day, And they shall never again see the face of the sinners and the ungodly.
And the Most High shall preserve them, And they shall dwell in the light of Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 66 (Noah Fragment) reveals the instruments of final judgment: angels of punishment prepared to release measured/divided/weighed waters and fire upon the earth. These angels oversee the powers of waters, releasing them specifically on sinners, ungodly, and world-deceivers. The fallen (Watchers and associates) remain bound in earth’s valleys until the great day of consummation/judgment. On that day, Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ punishment drives them from earth’s face—perishing eternally. Righteous/elect are saved, never again seeing sinners’ faces; Most High preserves them to dwell forever in the light of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. This intensifies the cleansing theme: measured elements (water/fire) execute precise judgment, corruption eradicated, faithful eternally preserved in light—echoing Flood prototype but final/eschatological. Verse 1: Angels of punishment prepared to release powers of waters upon earth. Cross-refs: Revelation 16:1–4 (angels pour bowls… waters become blood… judgments); Revelation 8:8–9 (second angel… mountain burning… sea blood… creatures died); Psalm 29:10 (Yahuah (God) sits upon flood… King forever). Verse 2: Measure of waters—measured/divided/weighed/reckoned. Cross-refs: Job 38:8–11 (shut sea with doors… set bounds… proud waves broken); Psalm 135:7 (makes clouds… lightning for rain… wind from treasuries); Job 28:25 (weighs waters by measure… appoints measure for rain). Verse 3: Measure of fire—measured/divided/weighed/reckoned. Cross-refs: Job 38:22–23 (treasuries of snow/hail… reserved for time of trouble… day of battle/war); Isaiah 66:15–16 (Yahuah (God) comes with fire… chariots whirlwind… execute judgment with fire); Revelation 9:18 (third part men killed by fire/smoke/brimstone). Verse 4: Angels over powers of waters; release them. Cross-refs: Revelation 16:5 (angel of waters… righteous art Thou… judged thus); Revelation 7:1–3 (four angels holding four winds… do not harm until seal servants); Psalm 148:8 (fire/hail/snow/vapors/stormy wind… fulfill His word). Verse 5: Angels over waters release on sinners/ungodly/world-deceivers. Cross-refs: Revelation 16:6 (shed blood of saints/prophets… given blood to drink); 2 Peter 2:4–9 (angels sinned… reserved unto judgment… Noah preserved… righteous delivered from temptation); Jude 1:7 (Sodom/Gomorrah… suffering vengeance of eternal fire… example). Verse 6: Bound in valleys of earth until day of judgment/great consummation. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 10:12 (bind them… valleys of earth… seventy generations… great judgment); Revelation 20:1–3 (angel… chain… bind dragon… cast into bottomless pit… no more deceive until thousand years); Isaiah 24:21–22 (punish host of high ones… kings of earth… gathered prisoners in pit… shut up many days). Verse 7: Punishment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits comes; driven from earth’s face; perish forever. Cross-refs: Psalm 37:38 (transgressors destroyed together… posterity cut off); Obadiah 1:16 (swallow… as though never been); Revelation 20:10 (devil… tormented day/night forever); Zephaniah 1:2–3 (utterly consume all… man/beast/fowls/fishes). Verse 8: Righteous/elect saved on that day; never again see sinners/ungodly. Cross-refs: Isaiah 65:20 (no more… infant days/aged… sinner accursed); Revelation 21:4 (no more death/sorrow/crying/pain… former things passed away); Psalm 37:10 (yet a little while… wicked not be… diligently consider place… not be). Verse 9: Most High preserves them; dwell in light of Yahuah (God) of Spirits forever. Cross-refs: Psalm 36:9 (fountain of life… in Your light see light); Revelation 22:5 (no night… need no lamp/sun… Yahuah (God) Elohim (God) give light… reign forever); Isaiah 60:19–20 (Yahuah (God) everlasting light… days of mourning ended); 1 John 1:5–7 (Elohim (God) is light… no darkness… walk in light… fellowship). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 66 unveils the precision of final judgment—angels release measured waters/fire on sinners/deceivers; fallen remain bound in valleys until consummation. Yahuah (God) of Spirits drives wicked from earth—eternal perishing. Righteous/elect saved, preserved by Most High, dwelling forever in His light—never seeing ungodly again. This promises total cleansing: corruption’s end, faithful’s eternal light. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s measured judgment (water/fire/elements), binding of deceivers, and preservation of elect in His light align. Beware downplaying final separation or eternal consequences. Cling to Yahuah’s name—waters released on wicked, light eternal for righteous (Revelation 21:1–4; Isaiah 60:19–20). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; punishment drives out sin, light preserves the elect!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Final Punishment of the Fallen Angels; Binding and Torment

verses.text: And in those days the punishment of the fallen angels shall be consummated, And they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: And in the fire shall they be covered, And in the fire shall they be tormented.

And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel Shall take hold of them on that great day, And cast them on that day into the burning furnace, That Yahuah (God) of Spirits may take vengeance on them For their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan And leading astray those who dwell on the earth.
And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

And the Head of Days shall sit on the throne of His glory, And the books of the living shall be opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors shall stand before Him.

And the hearts of the holy shall be filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous has been offered, And the prayer of the righteous has been heard, And the blood of the righteous has been required before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
And in those days the punishment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits shall come upon the sinners, And upon the fallen angels, And upon their children.
And the earth shall be cleansed from all corruption, And from all unrighteousness, And from all sin, And from all iniquity.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 67 (Noah Fragment) details the consummation of punishment for the fallen angels: led to the abyss of fire, covered and tormented therein. Archangels Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Phanuel seize and cast them into the burning furnace on the great day, so Yahuah (God) of Spirits avenges their unrighteousness, Satan-subjection, and misleading earth’s dwellers. Earth/Sheol/hell return the dead (resurrection); Head of Days enthroned opens books of the living; heavenly host attends. Holy hearts rejoice—righteous number complete, prayers heard, blood avenged before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Punishment falls on sinners, fallen angels, and offspring; earth fully cleansed from corruption/unrighteousness/sin/iniquity. This echoes earlier resurrection/judgment motifs (ch. 51, 60), emphasizing vengeance on deceivers, vindication of righteous blood, and total purification—preparing for eternal light/worship. Verse 1: Punishment of fallen angels consummated; led to abyss of fire; covered/tormented in fire. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:10 (devil cast into lake of fire/brimstone… tormented day/night forever); Matthew 25:41 (everlasting fire prepared for devil/angels); Jude 1:7 (eternal fire… suffering vengeance); Isaiah 66:24 (their worm not die… fire not quenched). Verse 2: Michael/Gabriel/Raphael/Phanuel take hold on great day; cast into burning furnace; Yahuah (God) of Spirits vengeance for unrighteousness/Satan-subjection/leading astray earth’s dwellers. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:1–3 (angel… chain… bind dragon… cast into bottomless pit); Daniel 12:1 (Michael stand up… great time of trouble); Revelation 12:7–9 (Michael/angels war… dragon cast out); 2 Peter 2:4 (angels sinned… cast down to hell… chains of darkness… judgment). Verse 3: Earth gives back entrusted; Sheol/hell give back received/owed (resurrection). Cross-refs: Revelation 20:13 (sea/death/hell gave up dead… judged every man according to works); John 5:28–29 (all in graves hear voice… come forth… resurrection life/judgment); Daniel 12:2 (many asleep in dust awake… everlasting life/contempt); Isaiah 26:19 (dead live… earth cast out dead). Verse 4: Head of Days sits on throne of glory; books of living opened before Him; heavenly host/counsellors stand before Him. Cross-refs: Daniel 7:9–10 (Ancient of Days takes seat… books opened… thousand thousands minister); Revelation 20:12 (books opened… judged by things written… book of life); Malachi 3:16 (book of remembrance… Yahuah (God) hearkens). Verse 5: Hearts of holy filled with joy—righteous number offered (complete), prayer heard, blood required (avenged) before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Revelation 6:9–11 (souls under altar cry “How long?”… given white robes… rest until number complete); Luke 18:7–8 (avenge elect who cry day/night… speedily); Genesis 4:10 (Abel’s blood cries from ground); Psalm 9:12 (Yahuah (God) remembers blood… avenges). Verse 6: Punishment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits on sinners/fallen angels/their children. Cross-refs: Revelation 20:14–15 (death/hell cast into lake… whosoever not in book of life cast in); 1 Enoch 10:15 (destroy children of Watchers… wipe out injustice); Jude 1:14–15 (Yahuah (God) comes… convict ungodly of all deeds). Verse 7: Earth cleansed from all corruption/unrighteousness/sin/iniquity. Cross-refs: 2 Peter 3:10–13 (day of Elohim (God)… heavens/elements melt… new heavens/earth righteousness dwells); Revelation 21:1–5 (new heaven/new earth… first passed away… no more sea… former things passed); Isaiah 65:17 (new heavens/new earth… former not remembered). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 67 consummates vengeance—fallen angels cast by archangels into burning furnace/abyss fire for misleading earth; resurrection returns dead for accounting; Head of Days opens books, holy rejoice in avenged blood/complete number. Yahuah (God) of Spirits punishes sinners/angels/offspring; earth cleansed utterly. Righteous preserved in joy. This seals: corruption’s end, blood cries answered, eternal fire for deceivers. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s vengeance on Watchers/deceivers, resurrection/judgment by books, and cleansing for righteous joy align. Beware softening angelic punishment or denying blood-avenging. Cling to Yahuah’s name—furnace awaits the fallen, books open for righteous, earth cleansed forever (Revelation 20:11–15; Psalm 9:7–8). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; great day avenges, joy fills the holy!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Names and Sins of the Fallen Watchers

verses.text: And these are the names of the chiefs of the two hundred angels who went down in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, And they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

And these are the names of their chiefs: Semjâzâ, who was their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zâqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl.
These are their chiefs of tens.
And these are the names of the chiefs over a hundred, over fifty and over ten.

And these are the names of their chiefs who were over a hundred: Semjâzâ, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zâqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl.
These are the chiefs of tens.

And these are the names of the chiefs who taught mankind: Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, And made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, And bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, And all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Samsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.
And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 68 (Noah Fragment) catalogs the 200 fallen Watchers’ chiefs, led by Semjâzâ, who descended on Mount Hermon, swore mutual oaths, and corrupted humanity. The list details their names and hierarchy (chiefs of tens/hundreds), then their specific sins: Azâzêl taught weapons/metallurgy/cosmetics/jewelry (leading to violence/vanity/fornication/corruption); others taught enchantments, root-cuttings (sorcery), astrology/constellations, cloud/earth/sun/moon signs—prohibited knowledge that led mankind astray and into godlessness. Humanity’s resulting cry ascended to heaven, prompting divine response (judgment/binding from prior chapters). This chapter exposes the origin of forbidden arts, violence, and idolatry—rooted in angelic rebellion—emphasizing Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ ultimate accountability for all who lead astray. Verse 1: Chiefs of 200 angels descended in Jared’s days on Mount Hermon summit; called Hermon because swore/bound by mutual imprecations. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 6:3–6 (Semjâzâ said… let us swear… bind ourselves… mutual imprecations… summit Hermon); Deuteronomy 3:8–9 (Hermon called Sirion/Senir—location tie); Genesis 6:1–2 (sons of Elohim (God) saw daughters… took wives). Verse 2–6: Names of chiefs (Semjâzâ leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, etc.); chiefs of tens/hundreds/fifties/tens. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 6:7 (list of chiefs); Jude 1:6 (angels kept not first estate… left habitation… chains under darkness); 2 Peter 2:4 (angels sinned… cast down to hell… chains of darkness… judgment). Verse 7–8: Azâzêl taught swords/knives/shields/breastplates; metals/working them; bracelets/ornaments/antimony/eyelids beautifying; costly stones/colouring tinctures; much godlessness, fornication, led astray, corrupt in all ways. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:5,11 (wickedness great… earth filled with violence); 1 Enoch 8:1 (Azâzêl taught… made known metals… bracelets… antimony… eyelids… stones… tinctures); Revelation 9:20–21 (not repent sorceries/fornication/thefts); Isaiah 3:16–24 (haughty daughters… ornaments… stench instead of girdle… burning instead beauty). Verse 9: Semjâzâ taught enchantments/root-cuttings; Armârôs resolving enchantments; Barâqîjâl astrology; Kôkabêl constellations; Êzêqêêl clouds; Araqiêl earth signs; Samsiêl sun signs; Sariêl moon course. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 18:10–12 (no diviner/sorcerer/enchantment… abomination to Yahuah (God)); Isaiah 47:12–13 (stand with enchantments… astrologers… star-gazers… cannot save); Acts 19:19 (books of curious arts… burned… value fifty thousand pieces silver); Galatians 5:19–20 (works of flesh… idolatry/witchcraft). Verse 10: As men perished, cried; cry went up to heaven. Cross-refs: Genesis 4:10 (Abel’s blood cries from ground); Genesis 18:20 (cry of Sodom/Gomorrah great… sin very grievous); Exodus 2:23–24 (children of Israel sighed/groaned… cry came up… Elohim (God) heard); Revelation 6:9–10 (souls under altar cry… How long… avenge our blood?). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 68 names the Watchers’ chiefs and exposes their corruption—Azâzêl’s weapons/vanity teachings sparked violence/fornication; others’ sorcery/astrology/sign-reading led to godlessness. Humanity’s cry ascended, invoking Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ judgment (binding/fire from prior). This reveals forbidden knowledge’s origin—angelic rebellion—and warns against all such arts (enchantments, astrology, metallurgy for war/vanity). Discern: Teachings identifying these sins as abomination, affirming Yahuah’s response to cries, and rejecting occult/astrological compromise align. Beware modern equivalents (occult, vanity-driven tech, star-sign reliance). Cling to Yahuah’s name—He hears cries, binds deceivers, purges corruption (Deuteronomy 18:10–12; Revelation 21:8 sorcerers in lake of fire). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; cry ascends, judgment falls on the fallen!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Continued – Further Names and Teachings of the Fallen Watchers; The Oath and Judgment

verses.text: And after this judgement they shall terrify and make them to tremble because they have shown this to those who dwell on the earth.

And behold the names of those angels! and these are their names: the first of them is Semjâzâ, the second Artâqîfâ, the third Armên, the fourth Kôkabêl, the fifth Tûrâêl, the sixth Rûmjâl, the seventh Dânjâl, the eighth Nûqâêl, the ninth Barâqêl, the tenth Azâzêl, the eleventh Armârôs, the twelfth Batarjâl, the thirteenth Busasêjal, the fourteenth Hanânêl, the fifteenth Tûrêl, the sixteenth Sîmâpêsîêl, the seventeenth Jetârêl, the eighteenth Tûmâêl, the nineteenth Târêl, the twentieth Rûmâêl, the twenty-first Izêzêêl.
And these are the chiefs of their angels and the names of their chief ones over a hundred and over fifty and over ten.
These are the names of the chiefs of tens.

And these are the names of the chiefs who taught mankind: Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, ‘Armârôs the resolving of enchantments,’ Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Samsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.
The name of the first Jeqôn: that is, the one who led astray [all] the sons of Elohim (God), and brought them down to the earth, and led them astray through the daughters of men.
And the second was named Asbeêl: he imparted to the holy sons of Elohim (God) evil counsel, and led them astray so that they defiled their bodies with the daughters of men.

And the third was named Gâdreêl: he it is who showed the children of men all the blows of death, and he led astray Eve, and showed [the weapons of death to the sons of Adam] the shield and the coat of mail, and the sword for battle, and all the weapons of death to the children of men.
And from his hand they have proceeded against those who dwell on the earth from that day and for evermore.
And the fourth was named Pênemûe: he taught the children of men the bitter and the sweet, and he taught them all the secrets of their wisdom.
And he instructed mankind in writing with ink and paper, and thereby many sinned from eternity to eternity and until this day.
For men were not created for such a purpose, to give confirmation to their good faith with pen and ink.

For men were created exactly like the angels, to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous, and death, which destroys everything, could not have taken hold of them, but through this their knowledge they are perishing, and through this power †it is consuming me†.

And the fifth was named Kâsdejâ: this is he who showed the children of men all the wicked smitings of spirits and demons, and the smitings of the embryo in the womb, that it may pass away, and [the smitings of the soul] the bites of the serpent, and the smitings which befall through the noontide heat, the son of the serpent named Tabâ’ět.
And this is the †task† of Kâsbeêl, the chief of the oath which he showed to the holy ones when he dwelt high above in glory, and its name is Bîqâ.

This angel requested Michael to show him the hidden name, that he might enunciate it in the oath, so that those might quake before that name and oath who revealed all that was in secret to the children of men.
And this is the power of this oath, for it is powerful and strong, and he placed this oath Akâe in the hand of Michael.
And these are the secrets of this oath, and they are strong through his oath: and the heaven was suspended before the world was created, and for ever.
And through it the earth was founded upon the water, and from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, from the creation of the world and unto eternity.
And through that oath the sea was created, and †as its foundation† He set for it the sand against the time of its anger, and it dare not pass beyond it from the creation of the world unto eternity.
And through that oath are the depths made fast, and abide and stir not from their place from eternity to eternity.
And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course, and deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.
And through that oath the stars complete their course, and He calls them by their names, and they answer Him from eternity to eternity.
[And in like manner the spirits of the water, and of the winds, and of all zephyrs, and their paths from all the quarters of the winds.

And there are preserved the voices of the thunder and the light of the lightnings: and there are preserved the chambers of the hail and the chambers of the hoar-frost, and the chambers of the mist, and the chambers of the rain and the dew.

And all these believe and give thanks before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and glorify Him with all their power, and their food is in every act of thanksgiving: they thank and glorify and extol the name of Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.]
And this oath is mighty over them, and through it [they are preserved and] their paths are preserved, and their course is not destroyed.
And there was great joy amongst them, and they blessed and glorified and extolled because the name of that son of Adam had been revealed unto them.

And he sat on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgement was given unto the son of Adam, and he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, and those who have led the world astray.
With chains shall they be bound, and in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, and all their works vanish from the face of the earth.

And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible; for that son of Adam has appeared, and has seated himself on the throne of his glory, and all evil shall pass away before his face, and the word of that son of Adam shall go forth and be strong before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven.

And Michael, one of the holy and honoured, who was with me, answered and said unto me: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.
Because these are the ones who revealed the eternal secrets which were in heaven, which men were striving to learn: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.
And they went to the daughters of men upon the earth, and had intercourse with the women, and defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.
And now, behold, the spirits of the souls of the dead shall rise up, and their cry shall reach unto heaven, and their lamentation shall reach unto the gates of heaven.
And now, behold, the angels who have had intercourse with women shall raise up their spirits against the children of men, and against the women, because they have gone forth from them.’

chapters.commentary: Chapter 69 expands the catalog of the fallen Watchers from ch. 68, listing more chiefs (Semjâzâ, Artâqîfâ, Armên, etc.) and reiterating their hierarchy and teachings: Azâzêl’s weapons/metals/cosmetics, Semjâzâ’s enchantments/root-cuttings, others’ astrology/constellations/clouds/earth signs/sun/moon courses. Humanity’s corruption (godlessness, fornication, blood/unrighteousness) fills earth, prompting cries to heaven. Michael declares this judgment a testimony against kings/mighty who possess earth, for revealing heavenly secrets men sought. Watchers defiled themselves with women, producing giants, filling earth with blood. Spirits of dead souls rise, cry reaches heaven’s gates; angels’ spirits rise against men/women from whom they went forth. This intensifies the accusation: forbidden knowledge caused total corruption, cries invoke Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ vengeance, giants’ spirits persist in enmity—leading to final judgment. Verse 1: After judgement, terrify/make tremble for showing this to earth-dwellers. Cross-refs: Revelation 6:15–17 (kings/mighty hide… terror… who stand?); Isaiah 2:19–21 (men hide in rocks… terror of Yahuah (God)… shake earth). Verse 2–4: Names of angels/chiefs (Semjâzâ first, Artâqîfâ, Armên, etc.); chiefs of hundreds/fifties/tens. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 6:7 (similar list); Jude 1:6 (angels… chains… judgment); 2 Peter 2:4 (angels sinned… hell… judgment). Verse 5–6: Azâzêl taught swords/knives/shields/breastplates/metals/bracelets/ornaments/antimony/eyelids/stones/tinctures; godlessness/fornication/led astray/corrupt ways. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:11 (earth filled with violence); 1 Enoch 8:1 (Azâzêl… metals… antimony… eyelids); Isaiah 3:18–24 (ornaments… stench… burning). Verse 7: Semjâzâ enchantments/root-cuttings; Armârôs resolving; Barâqîjâl astrology; Kôkabêl constellations; Êzêqêêl clouds; Araqiêl earth; Samsiêl sun; Sariêl moon. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 4:19 (not worship sun/moon/stars); Isaiah 47:13 (astrologers… cannot save); Galatians 5:20 (witchcraft… idolatry). Verse 8: Men perished, cried; cry up to heaven. Cross-refs: Genesis 18:20 (cry of Sodom great); Exodus 3:7 (Yahuah (God): seen affliction… heard cry); Revelation 6:10 (cry… avenge blood). Verse 9–10: Michael: Judgment testimony for kings/mighty; revealed eternal secrets in heaven men sought; Semjâzâ given authority over associates. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 29:29 (secret things belong to Yahuah (God)… revealed to us/children forever); Amos 3:7 (Yahuah (God) reveals secret to servants prophets); Daniel 2:28 (Elohim (God) reveals secrets). Verse 11–12: Went to daughters of men, intercourse, defiled; revealed sins; women bore giants; earth filled blood/unrighteousness. Cross-refs: Genesis 6:2,4 (sons of Elohim (God)… took wives… giants); Numbers 13:33 (giants… grasshoppers); Wisdom 14:6 (giants perished). Verse 13–14: Spirits of dead souls rise, cry to heaven/gates; angels’ spirits rise against men/women (from whom went forth). Cross-refs: Genesis 4:10 (blood cries); Revelation 6:9–10 (souls cry… avenge); Isaiah 26:21 (Yahuah (God) comes… avenge blood… earth disclose blood); Hebrews 12:24 (blood of sprinkling speaks better than Abel). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 69 names more Watchers/chiefs, details their forbidden teachings (weapons, sorcery, astrology, signs), leading to universal corruption/giants/bloodshed. Cries ascend, Michael declares judgment as testimony against powerful who seek/reveal secrets. Angels’ defilement/giants fill earth with unrighteousness; spirits rise in enmity. This exposes root of occult/violence/idolatry—angelic rebellion—and affirms Yahuah (God) of Spirits hears cries, judges revealers. Discern: Teachings rejecting all such arts (astrology/sorcery/vanity/weapons), affirming judgment on deceivers, and calling to heed cries align. Beware embracing “hidden knowledge” from forbidden sources. Cling to Yahuah’s name—He binds oath-breakers, hears blood cries, avenges unrighteousness (Deuteronomy 18:10–12; Revelation 21:8). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; secrets revealed bring judgment, cries bring deliverance! Gâdreêl and the Tares Sown into the Seed of Adam Of all the chief names in the catalog, verse 10 carries a weight the pulpit has never taught. “And the third was named Gâdreêl: he it is who showed the children of men all the blows of death, and he led astray Eve, and showed … the sword for battle, and all the weapons of death to the children of men.” Read that line again. The Watcher who led astray Eve. Not the serpent of Genesis 3 considered generically. A named heavenly rebel who reached into the very first covenant woman and pulled her toward death. Enoch names him. This is the verse the seed-war framework hinges on. Scripture begins with a distinction that most readers quietly lose: Yahuah (God) created the nations first in Genesis 1, then set Adam apart in Genesis 2 to tend the garden. He could have given Adam a wife from those already-existing nations. He did not. He formed Eve from Adam himself, inside the new covenant line, so that the seed of promise would begin clean, from inside, pure to its own root. Two good groups stood at the outset — the Adamic covenant line and the Genesis 1 nations — and no tares in either. Then the Watchers descended. Genesis 6 records the Watcher-and-daughters-of-men stream — the Nephilim line and their spiritual heirs, seed of Belial sown into the nations. Enoch 69:10 records the other stream, the one Genesis 3 recorded in veiled form: Gâdreêl reached Eve, Eve reached Adam, and the tares were sown into the covenant field itself. Cain is the fruit of that sowing. Yahusha (Jesus) spoke the lineage plainly to the religious rulers of His day — “ye are of your father the devil” (John 8:44) — and He was not speaking metaphorically. He was naming a seed. The sons of Belial in Moses’ seat. Cainite lineage inside the covenant house. So the war of two seeds spoken in Genesis 3:15 has three lineages walking the earth: sons of Adam (the covenant seed), the plain-ol’ other nations (Genesis 1 humanity, good, older than Adam, the surviving-nations of the age to come), and the sons of Belial (tares sown into both good fields — into the nations via the Watchers, into the Adamic seed via Gâdreêl and Eve). Wheat and tares grow together until the harvest (Matthew 13). The counterfeit is laid desolate in the holy land, then Yahusha (Jesus) stands on the Mount of Olives and wars the tares in the nations, then the wheat is gathered, the fruitful separated from the chaff, placed in the land of promise, given a new heart incapable of sin (Ezekiel 36:26; Jeremiah 31:33) — a kingdom of priests to the plain-ol’ other nations who survived. It will be like it was in the beginning before the fall. Sons of Adam and the other nations. No sons of Belial. Gâdreêl is why the Messiah had to come as a son of Adam. The redemption is of the seed, so the Redeemer comes of the seed. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:26–27 (the nations created first); Genesis 2:7, 2:18–24 (Adam formed separately; Eve from Adam, from inside the covenant line); Genesis 3:15 (enmity between the seed of the woman and the seed of the serpent); Genesis 4:1–8 (Cain slays Abel — the first fruit of the tares sown into the Adamic field); John 8:44 (“ye are of your father the devil” — Yahusha (Jesus) naming the Cainite lineage still alive in Moses’ seat); Matthew 13:24–30, 36–43 (wheat and tares grow together until the harvest); Ezekiel 36:26 (the new heart given to the gathered remnant); Jeremiah 31:33 (Torah written on the heart in the new covenant); 1 John 3:8–12 (Cain was of the wicked one — the seed-war named plainly). The Close of the Third Parable — The Son of Man on the Throne of Glory Verses 30–33 close the Third Parable the way it opened — with the Elect One. Great joy among the heavenly hosts, blessing and glorification, “because the name of that son of man had been revealed unto them.” He sits on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgement is given unto him. The sinners pass away. Those who led the world astray are bound with chains in their place of destruction. From henceforth, nothing corruptible — because that son of man has appeared, and has seated himself on the throne, and all evil passes away before his face, and his word goes forth strong before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. This is not Enoch on the throne. It is the Elect One — the one named before the sun and stars were created (Chapter 48:2–3), the one placed on the throne of glory by the Head of Days (Chapter 61:8), the Formed of the Formless who reveals Himself to Enoch throughout the thirty-five chapters of the Parables. Enoch sees. The Elect One is seen. Enoch announces. The Elect One is the announcement. Enoch is the son of Adam appointed before birth to behold and to witness. The Elect One is the son of Adam in the prophetic register — the Ancient of Days walking in the flesh, whom Enoch and Yahusha (Jesus) alone use that phrase to name. The Third Parable closes with the throne filled by Him, not by Enoch. Chapter 71 will not overturn that — it will confirm it, naming Enoch as a son of Adam in the creaturely register while the Elect One remains seated. Hold that distinction through Chapter 71 and nothing in the text will confuse you. Cross-refs: 1 Enoch 48:2–3 (named before the sun and stars); 1 Enoch 61:8 (placed on the throne of glory by the Head of Days); 1 Enoch 46:3 (righteousness dwells with him, reveals hidden things); Daniel 7:13–14 (one like a son of man coming with the clouds, given dominion); John 5:22 (the Father has committed all judgement unto the Son); Revelation 20:11–12 (the great white throne, and Him that sat upon it).

chapters.title: The Third Parable Concluded – Enoch’s Ascension and Final Visions

verses.text: And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.
And I saw two streams of fire, And the light of that fire shone like hyacinths, And I fell on my face before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
And the angel Michael seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.
And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.
And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
And my spirit longed to dwell in that place, And my spirit longed for that dwelling.
And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning of the world Dwell in that place.

And after that I saw the hidden things in heaven, The storehouses of the winds, And how the winds are divided, And how they are weighed in the balance, And how the fountains of the spirits are reckoned, Each according to the power of the spirit, The power of the lights of the moon, And according to the power that is in righteousness.
And after that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heaven of heavens: And I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
And my spirit longed to dwell in that place, And my spirit longed for that dwelling.
And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning of the world Dwell in that place.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 70 concludes the Third Parable (and the Parables section) with Enoch’s own ascension: his spirit is translated to the heavens, beholding holy sons of Elohim (God) stepping on flames, white-garmented, snow-faced. He falls before Yahuah (God) of Spirits; Michael lifts him, shows secrets of righteousness, heaven’s ends, star/luminarie chambers, crystal structures with living fire tongues. Enoch longs to dwell there, sees first fathers/righteous from world’s beginning inhabiting that place. Further visions: hidden storehouses of winds (divided/weighed/reckoned by spirit power, moon lights, righteousness). Repeated emphasis on longing for that crystal-fire dwelling with ancient righteous. This caps the Parables: from judgment on wicked/Watchers to exaltation of Enoch (prototype for elect), eternal dwelling in light/fire/righteousness before Yahuah (God) of Spirits—hope for the faithful amid corruption’s end. Verse 1: Spirit translated/ascended into heavens; saw holy sons of Elohim (God) stepping on flames; garments white/raiment, faces shone like snow. Cross-refs: Revelation 7:9 (great multitude… white robes… palms); Daniel 7:9 (Ancient of Days… garment white as snow); Matthew 28:3 (angel… countenance like lightning… raiment white as snow); Revelation 3:4–5 (few names… walk in white… worthy). Verse 2: Two streams of fire; light like hyacinths; fell on face before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Ezekiel 1:27–28 (appearance of fire… brightness round about… glory of Yahuah (God)… fell on face); Revelation 4:5 (seven lamps of fire burning before throne… spirits of Elohim (God)); Daniel 10:5–6 (body like beryl… face like appearance of lightning). Verse 3: Michael seized right hand, lifted, led into all secrets; showed secrets of righteousness. Cross-refs: Revelation 1:17 (touched me… fear not); Daniel 10:10,18 (hand touched me… set me upon knees); Revelation 19:10 (fell at feet to worship… angel: see thou do it not… fellowservant). Verse 4: Secrets of ends of heaven; chambers of stars/luminaries; proceed before holy ones. Cross-refs: Job 38:31–33 (bind sweet influences of Pleiades… ordinances of heaven); Psalm 147:4 (numbers stars… calls by names); Isaiah 40:26 (brings out host by number… calls by name). Verse 5–6: Spirit translated to heaven of heavens; structure of crystals, tongues of living fire between; spirit longed to dwell there. Cross-refs: Revelation 21:11,18–21 (city… jasper… pure gold like clear glass… foundations garnished with jewels… crystal); Revelation 22:1 (river of water of life… crystal); Psalm 27:4 (dwell in house of Yahuah (God)… behold beauty… inquire in temple). Verse 7,9–11: Saw first fathers/righteous from beginning of world dwelling there (repeated for emphasis). Cross-refs: Hebrews 11:13–16 (strangers/pilgrims… sought better country… prepared city); Revelation 21:3 (Elohim (God) dwells with men); Psalm 16:11 (path of life… fullness of joy… pleasures at right hand forever); Isaiah 57:1–2 (righteous taken away… enter peace… rest in beds). Verse 8: Hidden storehouses of winds; divided/weighed in balance; fountains of spirits reckoned by power of spirit, moon lights, righteousness. Cross-refs: Job 38:24–27 (path for lightning… rain on land… satisfy waste); Psalm 135:7 (makes clouds… lightning for rain… wind from storehouses); Job 28:25 (weighs waters by measure… appoints measure for rain). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 70 exalts Enoch’s translation—spirit ascends, beholds heavenly holy ones in white/snow/fire, crystal-fire structures, longing for eternal dwelling with first fathers/righteous from world’s beginning. Secrets of righteousness/heaven/stars/winds revealed by Michael before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. This foreshadows elect’s ultimate home: light, fire, crystal purity, rest with ancient faithful—after judgment on corruption. Discern: Teachings promising translation/ascension for righteous, eternal dwelling in Yahuah’s light, and longing fulfilled in His presence align. Beware denying bodily/spiritual exaltation or heavenly order. Cling to Yahuah’s name—spirit longs for crystal-fire place, righteous dwell there forever (Revelation 21:1–4; Psalm 16:11). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; translation comes, longing ends in glory!

chapters.title: The Third Parable Concluded – Enoch’s Exaltation; Revelation of the Son of Man

verses.text: And it came to pass after this that my spirit was carried off and it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white, and their raiment, And their faces shone like snow.
And I saw two streams of fire, And the light of that fire shone like hyacinths, And I fell on my face before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
And the angel Michael seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.
And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.
And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
And my spirit longed to dwell in that place, And my spirit longed for that dwelling.
