And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning of the world Dwell in that place.

And after that I saw the hidden things in heaven, The storehouses of the winds, And how the winds are divided, And how they are weighed in the balance, And how the fountains of the spirits are reckoned, Each according to the power of the spirit, The power of the lights of the moon, And according to the power that is in righteousness.
And after that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heaven of heavens: And I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
And my spirit longed to dwell in that place, And my spirit longed for that dwelling.
And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning of the world Dwell in that place.
And after that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heaven of heavens: And I saw there a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.

And my spirit longed to dwell in that place, And my spirit longed for that dwelling. (Note: Some editions have minor textual repetition or expansion in the ascent descriptions for emphasis on Enoch’s longing and the heavenly order; Charles notes the visionary repetition as stylistic.)

chapters.commentary: Chapter 71 serves as the triumphant close to the Book of Parables: Enoch’s spirit is repeatedly translated upward—through heavens, to the heaven of heavens—beholding holy sons of Elohim (God) in white/snow/fire, crystal structures with living fire tongues, storehouses of winds/stars/luminaries weighed by righteousness. He falls before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, is lifted by Michael, shown secrets of righteousness/heaven. Deep longing arises to dwell there with the first fathers and righteous from the world’s beginning. The repeated ascent and vision underscore eternal dwelling in purity/light/fire before Yahuah (God) of Spirits—a prototype for the elect’s exaltation, mirroring the Elect One / Son of Man’s role. This ends the Parables: judgment on wicked/Watchers complete, secrets revealed, Enoch exalted to behold the righteous’ eternal home. Enoch’s Exaltation and the Identity Question the Parables Raise The existing Chapter 71 commentary ends with “prototype for the elect’s exaltation” — a correct and useful framing. But it does not address the textual controversy that sits underneath this chapter, and readers in Hebrew roots circles will have been exposed to it. Verse 1: Spirit translated/ascended into heavens; saw holy sons of Elohim (God) stepping on flames; garments white/raiment, faces snow-like. Cross-refs: Revelation 7:9–14 (multitude… white robes… washed in Lamb’s blood); Daniel 7:9 (Ancient of Days… garment white as snow); Matthew 17:2 (transfigured… face shine as sun… raiment white as light). Verse 2: Two streams of fire; light like hyacinths; fell on face before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: Ezekiel 1:27 (appearance of fire… brightness round… glory of Yahuah (God)); Revelation 4:5 (lamps of fire before throne… spirits of Elohim (God)); Daniel 10:5–6 (body like beryl… face lightning). Verse 3: Michael seizes right hand, lifts, leads into all secrets; shows secrets of righteousness. Cross-refs: Revelation 1:17 (touched me… fear not); Daniel 10:10,18 (hand touched… set upon knees); Revelation 19:10 (fellowservant… worship Elohim (God)). Verse 4: Secrets of heaven’s ends; chambers of stars/luminaries; proceed before holy ones. Cross-refs: Job 38:31–33 (ordinances of heaven); Psalm 147:4 (numbers stars… calls by names); Isaiah 40:26 (brings host by number… calls by name). Verse 5–6: Spirit to heaven of heavens; crystal structure, living fire tongues between; spirit longs to dwell. Cross-refs: Revelation 21:11,18–21 (city… jasper… gold like glass… foundations jewels… crystal); Revelation 22:1 (river… crystal); Psalm 27:4 (dwell in house of Yahuah (God)… behold beauty). Verse 7,11: Saw first fathers/righteous from world’s beginning dwelling there. Cross-refs: Hebrews 11:13–16 (strangers… sought heavenly country… prepared city); Revelation 21:3 (Elohim (God) dwells with men); Psalm 16:11 (path of life… fullness of joy). Verse 8–10: Hidden storehouses of winds; divided/weighed/reckoned by spirit power, moon lights, righteousness. Cross-refs: Job 38:24–27 (path lightning… rain measure); Psalm 135:7 (clouds… lightning… wind storehouses); Job 28:25 (weighs waters… measure rain). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 71 crowns the Parables with Enoch’s exaltation—spirit translated repeatedly to heaven of heavens, beholding crystal-fire purity, longing fulfilled in dwelling with ancient righteous before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Secrets of righteousness/heaven revealed by Michael. This foreshadows elect’s ultimate translation/rest: white garments, fire/light, eternal home after judgment. Discern: Teachings affirming ascension/exaltation for faithful, longing for Yahuah’s dwelling, and heavenly order align. Beware denying spiritual translation or heavenly inheritance. Cling to Yahuah’s name—spirit ascends, fire tongues blaze, righteous dwell forever (Revelation 21:1–4; Psalm 16:11). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; Parables end in glory, longing satisfied in His presence! A teaching circulates in certain Hebrew roots and Sacred Name communities that Chapter 71 identifies Enoch as the Son of Man — and from there, as the Messiah or as God in the flesh. The second error is the one that requires correction. The first is simply a misreading of a title. Son of man — ben adam — means son of Adam. It is a seed-designation, not a title locked to one use, and it works in two registers through Scripture. In the creaturely register it addresses a righteous human of the Adamic line: Ezekiel ninety-three times, Enoch himself in 60:10 and 71:14, every prophet of the Adamic line. You are of Adam. You stand in the covenant lineage. It is not an exaltation — it is a designation of origin. In the prophetic register it names the Formed of the Formless coming to walk as a son of Adam: the Elect One in Parables 46, 48, 62, 63, and 69:30–33; the one named before the sun and stars were created (Chapter 48:2–3); the one placed on the throne of glory by the Head of Days to judge all kings and mighty (Chapter 61:8); the one in whom righteousness dwells eternally and who reveals all hidden treasures (Chapter 46:3); Daniel 7:13 coming with the clouds; and Yahusha (Jesus) quoting that exact Enochian usage in the Gospels. Both uses rest on the same core. For the creature it says you are of. For the Messiah it says He will come as. The Messiah had to come as a son of Adam because the covenant seed is Adamic and the redemption is of that seed. Charles’s error was treating son of man as exclusively the prophetic register, so when Chapter 71 plainly placed the address on Enoch he rewrote the grammar to hide it. The reverse error — treating son of man as exclusively the creaturely register, and therefore denying that the Parables ever use the phrase for the coming Messiah — flattens the book in the opposite direction. Either error misreads the text. The Parables use both registers. Chapter 71’s address to Enoch is in the creaturely one — son of Adam, covenant lineage, appointed before birth. The earlier chapters that call the Elect One the son of man carry the prophetic one, and only Enoch and Yahusha (Jesus) use the phrase that way for the Ancient of Days walking in the flesh. That is the Christological depth behind Yahusha’s self-designation. What Enoch is not is the Elect One. The address in Chapter 71 confirms his lineage — son of Adam — not his enthronement. The two figures do not collapse into one. The Parables establish the distinction across thirty-five chapters before the address to Enoch arrives, and Chapter 71 does not overturn that distinction. It honors it. Enoch sees Him. Falls before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in His presence. Is lifted by Michael. Is shown the secrets. He is the witness. The Elect One is the one witnessed. Now — Enoch’s appointment is real and it runs deep. His name was written in the book of life before the foundations of the world were laid. There is no other way to account for what the canon itself says of him. A man does not walk with Elohim (God) for three hundred years and translate without death by his own effort or spiritual discipline. The walking expressed what was already written. The translation confirmed what was already appointed. Before Yered fathered him, before he drew his first breath, before he took his first step with Elohim (God) — it was already written. This makes him the clearest pre-flood demonstration of what election actually produces in an Adamic man. Not sinless perfection. He carried the flesh and the chaff like every son of Adam. But a man so refined through his walk, so aligned with the will of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, that when the appointed time came the threshing was complete and death had nothing to take hold of. Elohim (God) took him because the grain was clean. And what did this most exalted pre-flood man do with his appointment? He pointed forward. Every vision, every parable, every woe and blessing across 108 chapters announces something coming — the Elect One coming, the judgment coming, the gathering coming, the restoration coming. Enoch is a finger. The Elect One is what the finger points at. Jude quotes him: Behold, Yahuah (God) comes with ten thousands of His set-apart ones (Jude 1:14–15). He announces the coming. He does not announce himself. The parallel is John the Baptist — the other forerunner, coming in the spirit of Elijah, the other man Scripture records as taken without death. Both appointed before birth. Both filled with the Spirit. Both separated and set apart. Both with one message: He is coming, and I am not Him. John said it explicitly when the crowds pressed him (John 1:20–23). Enoch said it across the entire Parables in vision form. The error takes the greatest witness and makes him the one witnessed. It flatters the witness. It obscures the Messiah. And it cannot be sustained by the Parables read sequentially — because the Parables themselves, across 35 chapters, have already shown who the Elect One is and shown Enoch as the one beholding Him. Test it simply: the Elect One was named before creation. Enoch was born in the seventh generation from Adam. These are not the same figure. The son of man address in Chapter 71 honors Enoch as exactly what he was — the most faithful Adamic son of his age, appointed before the foundations, refined through his walk, taken up to behold what was coming, and faithful to announce it until Elohim (God) took him home. Cross-refs: Genesis 5:22–24 (Enoch walked with Elohim (God) three hundred years — Elohim (God) took him); 1 Enoch 48:2–3 (the son of man named before sun and stars — the prophetic register for the Elect One); 1 Enoch 61:8 (Head of Days places Elect One on throne — enthroned by the Father); Jude 1:14–15 (Enoch prophesied — he announces, does not claim); Revelation 20:12 (book of life — names written before foundation); John 1:20–23 (John: I am not the Christ — the forerunner denies the role); Ezekiel 2:1 (son of man — the creaturely register, a son-of-Adam designation to a righteous prophet); Daniel 7:13–14 (one like a son of man with clouds — the Elect One’s visionary appearance before the Ancient of Days); Revelation 1:17–18 (First and Last, Living One, was dead and lives — the Elect One’s full self-declaration). What R.H. Charles Did to the Text — And What We Have Restored Every “complete” English Enoch in circulation descends from R.H. Charles’s 1917 translation. Charles was a careful textual scholar in every respect but one: he was committed to the theological assumption that “Son of Man” was an exclusively messianic title reserved for the Messiah, and he could not accept that Enoch 71 placed that phrase on Enoch. So he altered the text in two specific ways, and every edition downstream of him has inherited both alterations. First — the grammar. The Ethiopic manuscripts preserve a direct address: the angel comes to Enoch, greets him, and says “You are that son of man who was born unto righteousness.” Second person. The angel is speaking to Enoch about Enoch. Charles could not translate that sentence as it stands, because to his framework a non-Messiah receiving the “Son of Man” identification broke everything. So he rewrote it as “This is the Son of Man who is born unto righteousness” — third person. The address to Enoch becomes a description of a separate figure. He added the parenthetical “(i.e. the angel)” to clarify that it is the angel speaking, and he capitalized the pronouns (“greeted me with His voice”) to push the speech toward divinity. None of those changes has manuscript support. The Ethiopic reads plainly. Second — the fabricated “lost passage” note. At verse 13 Charles inserted a bracketed editorial note claiming a passage was lost from the manuscript tradition, in which the Son of Man accompanied the Head of Days and Enoch asked an angel who he was. No such lost passage exists in any Ethiopic manuscript. Charles invented it to create a gap between Enoch’s question and the angel’s answer, so that the “you are that son of man” identification could be redirected onto a separate messianic figure he imagined the missing text had described. The invention is not textual criticism. It is theological redirect dressed as textual criticism. Charles also capitalized “Son of Man” throughout the Parables (eighteen occurrences, chapters 46 through 71), reading it as a messianic title in every instance. The Ethiopic uses the descriptive phrase — the same kind of phrase Elohim (God) uses to address Ezekiel ninety-three times and to address Enoch in chapter 60:10. Charles was not translating; he was imposing. We have decapitalized the phrase throughout this edition to restore the plain reading. The restorations in this edition: the direct address is returned to the text — “You are that son of man.” The fabricated lost-passage note is removed and flagged. “Son of man” is set in lowercase across the Parables to match its grammar. “Heathen” is translated simply as “nations.” Interpretive parenthetical glosses that redirect rather than clarify are stripped. What emerges is the Parables as the Ethiopic actually records them: Enoch beholds the Elect One across thirty-five chapters, receives the son-of-Adam address in Chapter 71 that confirms his lineage and his office, and the throne stays filled by the one he has been witnessing. The witness remains the witness. The Elect One remains the Messiah. The text is clear once Charles’s corrections are corrected.

chapters.title: The Book of the Courses of the Heavenly Luminaries – The Laws of the Sun

verses.text: The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel who was with me, who was their leader, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.
And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.

And I saw six portals out of which the sun rises, and six portals in which the sun sets and the moon rises and sets in those portals, and the leaders of the stars and those whom they lead: six in the east and six in the west following them closely, and also many other when they are added to the six.
And the great one is their leader, the great luminary which is named the Sun, and its chariot on which it ascends is driven by the wind, and its chariot descends with wind.
And the sun rises from that fourth portal, and sets in the fourth, the western one.
And in the days of the month the sun rises from the second portal, and sets in the second, the western one.
And in those days the sun is above the earth, and its chariot ascends to the north and descends to the south.
And in the days of the month the sun rises from the third portal, and sets in the third, the western one.
And in the days of the month the sun rises from the first portal, and sets in the first, the western one.
And in the days of the month the sun rises from the sixth portal, and sets in the sixth, the western one.
And in the days of the month the sun rises from the fifth portal, and sets in the fifth, the western one.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 72 opens the Astronomical Book with Enoch’s vision from Uriel (angel of luminaries): the eternal laws of sun, moon, stars—courses, gates, seasons, names, dominion—unchanging till new creation. Focus on sun: rises/sets through six eastern/western portals (gates), chariot driven by wind. Annual circuit: rises/sets in different portals by month (fourth, second, third, first, sixth, fifth), ascending north/descending south. This reveals divine order—Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elyon’s precise governance of time/seasons through heavenly gates, contrasting human chaos/corruption (prior books). Sun’s leadership over stars, measured paths, eternal reliability testify to Elohim’s faithfulness. Verse 1: Book of courses of luminaries; relations/classes/dominion/seasons/names/places/months; Uriel showed laws exactly for all years/world till new creation/eternity. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14–18 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years… greater light rule day… lesser night); Psalm 136:7–9 (made great lights… sun rule day… moon/stars night); Jeremiah 31:35 (Yahuah (God) appoints sun/moon/stars… ordinances of heaven/earth); Revelation 21:1 (new heaven/new earth… first passed away). Verse 2: First law of luminaries: Sun rises eastern portals, sets western portals of heaven. Cross-refs: Psalm 19:4–6 (sun tabernacle… bridegroom… runs course… nothing hidden from heat); Ecclesiastes 1:5 (sun rises… hastens to place… rises there). Verse 3: Six portals east/six west for sun/moon rise/set; leaders of stars/followers; many others added to six. Cross-refs: Job 38:31–33 (bind Pleiades… loose Orion’s bands… ordinances of heaven); Isaiah 40:26 (brings out host by number… calls by name… power/strength). Verse 4: Great luminary Sun; chariot ascends/descends by wind. Cross-refs: Psalm 104:3 (lays beams in waters… chariot on wings of wind); Habakkuk 3:8–11 (chariots of salvation… sun/moon stood still… at light of arrows). Verse 5: Sun rises fourth portal, sets fourth western. Cross-refs: (Symbolic gates; cf. Zechariah 6:1–8 four chariots/winds… portals/directions). Verse 6: Days of month sun rises second portal, sets second western. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years—ordered progression). Verse 7: Days of month sun above earth; chariot ascends north, descends south. Cross-refs: Job 37:17–18 (garments hot… sky strong… molten mirror); Psalm 19:6 (circuit from end heaven… nothing hid from heat). Verse 8: Days of month sun rises third portal, sets third western. Cross-refs: (Continued annual shift; 364-day solar calendar implied in Enoch tradition). Verse 9: Days of month sun rises first portal, sets first western. Cross-refs: (Portal sequence reflects solstices/equinoxes progression). Verse 10: Days of month sun rises sixth portal, sets sixth western. Cross-refs: (Six gates symbolize complete cycle). Verse 11: Days of month sun rises fifth portal, sets fifth western. Cross-refs: (Completes annual circuit description). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 72 unveils Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elyon’s unchangeable laws—sun’s six gates, chariot-wind, monthly/annual circuit—governing time/seasons eternally till new creation. Uriel reveals precision/order, testifying to divine faithfulness amid human corruption (prior books). This calls to honor Yahuah’s ordinances, reject chaos/sorcery (Watchers’ teachings), and trust heavenly reliability. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s sovereign order in creation (gates/portals/chariot), eternal laws, and new creation hope align. Beware denying divine timekeeping or mixing with forbidden arts. Cling to Yahuah’s name—sun rises/sets by His gates, seasons keep faith, righteous await new heavens (Psalm 19:1–6; Jeremiah 31:35–36). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; luminaries declare glory, order endures forever!

chapters.title: The Laws of the Moon

verses.text: And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.
Her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is light, and her light is bright and soft.
And her form is like a horn when she is new, and when she is fourteen days old her light is full.
And her name is called the Moon, and her light waxes and wanes according to the number of days.
And the one half of her goes forth by a seventh part, and her whole circumference is empty, without light, with the exception of one-seventh part of it, and the fourteenth part of her light.
And when she receives one-seventh part of the half of her light, her light amounts to one-seventh part and the half thereof.

And she sets with the sun, and when the sun rises the moon rises with him and receives the half of one part of light, and in that night in the beginning of her morning [in the commencement of the lunar day] the moon sets with the sun, and is invisible that night with the fourteen parts and the half of one of them.
And she rises on that day with exactly a seventh part, and comes forth and recedes from the rising of the sun, and in her remaining days she becomes bright in the remaining thirteen parts.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 73 shifts focus to the moon (the “smaller luminary”), revealed by Uriel: her chariot light/soft/bright, form like a horn at new moon, full at 14–15 days. Monthly cycle: 30 days or 29 days to complete light (waxing from sun-reflected light). Her waxing and waning follow a precise cycle measured in sevenths. This highlights divine precision—Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim orders the moon’s phases, borrowing light from the sun, completing cycles in measured days to govern months/seasons. The ordered progression testifies to reliability: no deviation, eternal law till new creation. This contrasts human corruption (earlier books) with heavenly faithfulness—luminaries obey, testifying to Yahuah’s sovereignty. Verse 1: Another law for smaller luminary, named Moon. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:16 (made lesser light to rule night… stars); Psalm 136:9 (moon/stars to rule by night… mercy endures forever); Psalm 104:19 (made moon for seasons… sun knows going down). Verse 2: Circumference like heaven; chariot light; light bright/soft. Cross-refs: Psalm 19:1 (heavens declare glory… firmament shows handiwork); Job 38:31–33 (ordinances of heaven… moon/stars); Ecclesiastes 1:5–7 (sun/moon/wind… circuits). Verse 3: Form like horn when new; 14 days old light full. Cross-refs: Psalm 81:3 (blow trumpet in new moon… full moon on solemn feast); Isaiah 30:26 (light of moon as light of sun… light of sun sevenfold). Verse 4: Name Moon; light waxes/wanes by number of days. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Psalm 104:19 (moon for seasons); Jeremiah 31:35 (Elohim (God) appoints sun/moon… ordinances). Verse 5: One half of her goes forth by a seventh part; circumference empty except one-seventh and the fourteenth part of her light. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:16 (lesser light for the night); Psalm 136:9 (moon/stars to rule by night). Verse 6: Receives one-seventh part of half her light; her light is a seventh part and the half thereof. Cross-refs: (lunar phases by sevenths; measured divine order). Verse 7: Sets with the sun; rises with him; in the night of her morning the moon sets with the sun and is invisible that night with the fourteen parts and the half of one of them. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Psalm 104:19 (moon for seasons; sun knows going down). Verse 8: Rises that day with exactly a seventh part; recedes from the rising of the sun; in the remaining days she becomes bright in the remaining thirteen parts. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 31:35 (ordinances of moon/stars do not fail); Isaiah 40:26 (host by number—power/strength none fails). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 73 reveals Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s unchanging law for the moon—borrowed light from sun, horn-to-full cycle in 29/30 days, precise waxing to 15th-day fullness. No chaos; eternal obedience to divine measure. This testifies: luminaries keep covenant, seasons faithful, pointing to Yahuah’s order amid rebellion (Watchers’ corruption). Discern: Teachings honoring Yahuah’s creation laws (moon phases/gates), rejecting astrology/sorcery (forbidden teachings), and trusting heavenly reliability align. Beware mixing divine order with occult (astrology from fallen). Cling to Yahuah’s name—moon waxes by His law, full light declares glory (Psalm 104:19; Genesis 1:14–18). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; cycles endure, righteous observe His signs!

chapters.title: The Moon’s Gates and the Reckoning of the Year

verses.text: And afterwards the course of the moon was also completed in the six portals, as was shown to me there by the angel Uriel, who is the leader of all the luminaries.

And the moon also rises and sets through these portals, and in the first portal her light is full on the fifteenth day, and in the second portal her light is full on the thirteenth day, and in the third portal on the eleventh day, and in the fourth portal on the ninth day, and in the fifth portal on the seventh day, and in the sixth portal on the fifth day.
And again she returns and enters into the first portal in its season, and completes all her light in the east, and sets in the west.
And in certain months the moon passes through all the six portals, and in certain months she passes through five, and in certain months through four.
And in certain months she is seen twenty-nine days, and once thirty days, according to the circuit of all the luminaries.

And in the sixth portal the moon completes her light in five days, and in the fifth portal in seven days, and in the fourth portal in nine days, and in the third portal in eleven days, and in the second portal in thirteen days, and in the first portal in fifteen days.
And again she returns and enters into the first portal in its season, and completes all her light.

And thus she completes her waning in fifteen days, and in certain months in fourteen days, and in certain months in thirteen days, and in certain months in twelve days, and in certain months in eleven days.
And in certain months the moon completes all her light in thirty days, and once in twenty-nine days.
And the sun and the moon complete the year in three hundred and sixty-four days.
And therefore the days are deficient in the intercalated months by thirty days, for the lunar year is three hundred and fifty-four days, and the solar year three hundred and sixty-four days.
And the moon falls behind the sun and the stars by thirty days in the course of one year.

And the moon brings in all the years exactly, that their stations may come, and that they may not transgress their reckoned stations, and that they may not change their order, but complete the years with righteousness, three hundred and sixty-four days.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 74 reveals the moon’s circuit through the same six eastern/western portals as the sun, with light fullness varying by portal: 15th day in first, 13th in second, down to 5th in sixth—reflecting progressive waxing. Monthly variations: some 30 days, some 29; full light in 5–15 days depending on gate entry. Moon returns/repeats cycle. The chapter contrasts lunar year (354 days) with solar (364 days), noting the 10-day shortfall (no intercalation in this Enochic system), yet luminaries keep exact stations/orders without transgression, completing years in righteousness. This underscores Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s unchanging order: gates fixed, circuits faithful, no deviation—testifying to divine law over time/seasons, eternal till new creation. Chapter 74 records the 364-day count in the Enochic astronomy and the 354-day lunar reckoning side by side, without presenting either as the eternal measure of all years. Verse 1: Course of moon completed in six portals; Uriel showed as leader of luminaries. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:16 (lesser light rule night); Psalm 136:9 (moon/stars rule night… mercy forever); Jeremiah 31:35 (Elohim (God) appoints moon… ordinances). Verse 2: Moon rises/sets through portals; light full on 15th in first, 13th in second, 11th in third, 9th in fourth, 7th in fifth, 5th in sixth. Cross-refs: Psalm 104:19 (made moon for seasons); Ecclesiastes 1:5–7 (sun/moon circuits); (Symbolic gates; progression reflects observed phases). Verse 3: Returns/enters first portal in season; completes light in east, sets west. Cross-refs: Psalm 19:6 (circuit from end heaven… nothing hid from heat); Job 38:33 (ordinances of heaven… earth). Verse 4: Certain months through all six portals, some five, some four. Cross-refs: (Lunar path variation; Enochic astronomy). Verse 5: Certain months 29 days complete light, once 30. Cross-refs: Exodus 12:2 (this month first… new moon); Numbers 28:14 (new moons… offerings by number). Verse 6: Sixth portal 5 days full light; fifth 7, fourth 9, third 11, second 13, first 15. Cross-refs: (Waxing speed by gate; measured divine law). Verse 7: Returns/enters first portal in season; completes all light. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years). Verse 8: Waning in 15 days certain months; 14, 13, 12, 11 certain months. Cross-refs: (Waning symmetry to waxing; precise reckoning). Verse 9: Certain months 30 days complete light, once 29. Cross-refs: (Lunar month alternation; 354-day year). Verse 10: Sun/moon complete year in 364 days. Cross-refs: (364-day solar calendar; 52 exact weeks; Enochic/Qumran tradition); Genesis 1:14 (seasons/days/years ordered). Verse 11: Days deficient in intercalated months by 30; lunar 354, solar 364. Cross-refs: (364-day count recorded; no single count presented as eternal); Psalm 104:19 (seasons by moon… but sun rules day). Verse 12: Moon falls behind sun/stars by 30 days per year. Cross-refs: (moon and sun reckoned together; both under Yahuah’s appointed courses). Verse 13: Moon brings years exactly; stations not transgressed; no change order; complete years with righteousness, 364 days. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 31:35–36 (ordinances of moon/sun… not depart… Israel cease nation); Psalm 148:6 (established forever… decree not pass); Isaiah 40:26 (host by number… power/strength none fails). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 74 reveals Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s precise laws for moon—six gates, phase fullness by portal (5–15 days), 29/30-day months, 354-day lunar vs. 364-day solar year. Luminaries keep stations without transgression, completing cycles in righteousness—eternal order till new creation. This calls to honor Yahuah’s calendar as Torah gives it, rest in the moon and sun working together under His appointment, and trust heavenly faithfulness. Discern: Teachings that honor the covenant calendar (new moons marking months, feasts dated by lunar months, the two luminaries together marking the year) align. Beware teachings that lift a single number from this book and set it above Torah’s own feast calendar. Cling to Yahuah’s name—moon keeps gates, years complete righteously, righteous observe His signs (Psalm 104:19; Jeremiah 31:35). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; luminaries declare unchanging glory! On the Calendar — What Enoch Supports and What the Tsadoq Calendarists Twist This book supports a lunar month. Enoch’s chapters on the luminaries give the moon four full treatments (73, 74, 78, 79), and the new moon marks the beginning of a month in Torah and in Enoch alike. Feasts are dated by lunar months: Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month (Exodus 12:18), the Feast of Trumpets on the first of the seventh month (Leviticus 23:24), the Day of Atonement on the tenth (Leviticus 23:27), the Feast of Tabernacles on the fifteenth (Leviticus 23:34). The moon rules the month. The sun rules the day. The two together mark the year. That is the pattern Torah commands and the pattern Enoch describes. A teaching circulates — in some Zadokite-revival, Qumran-calendar, and Hebrew Roots circles — that Enoch’s 364-day count in chapter 74 is the eternal divinely-prescribed solar calendar, and that every lunar-based reckoning (including the Jewish reckoning of feasts by the new moon) is therefore corrupt. This is the Tsadoq calendarist position. It lifts one number from this book, makes it the unchanging standard, and uses it to overturn the lunar-month structure Torah itself commands. The 364-day count is not the unchanging standard that everything else was the effect of. It was the effect — the effect of keeping the lunar calendar before the sun both stood still and rewound. Joshua 10:12–14 records the sun stopping in the sky “about a whole day” at Joshua’s word. Isaiah 38:8 and 2 Kings 20:9–11 record the sun’s shadow retreating ten degrees on the dial of Ahaz at Hezekiah’s sign. These were real events, and Scripture records them plainly. They altered the astronomical reckoning after Enoch’s age. No fixed day-count — 364, 365.24, 354, any other — can hold through such events without periodic adjustment. Every calendar requires adjustment. Lunar months do not divide evenly into a solar year. Solar years do not divide evenly into 24-hour days; the Gregorian solar calendar that structures modern life requires a leap day every four years, with further century-based corrections, and even then drifts against observed astronomical time requiring leap-second additions. Saying “the lunar calendar needs adjustment” is true — and it is not unique to the lunar calendar. Every calendar needs adjustment. The argument fails the moment it is required to apply evenly. A solar system that demands reset cannot be held up as proof against a lunar system for demanding the same. Read the Book of the Heavenly Luminaries as what it is — a detailed record of celestial observations given to Enoch by Uriel, describing the courses of sun and moon as Enoch saw them in his astronomical age. It is not a replacement for Torah’s feast calendar. It is not a commandment that 364 days is the eternal measure of a year. Honor the sun and moon as Yahuah (God) set them. Honor the covenant calendar Torah gives. Do not let a single number lifted from one chapter override the whole pattern Scripture holds.

chapters.title: The Chiefs of the Luminaries and the Four Intercalary Days

verses.text: And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, also have their special stations, and they serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the four parts of the year, and over the four intercalary days, serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the seven days serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the months serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the years serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the seasons serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the days serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the hours serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.
And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the minutes serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places.

And the leaders of the heads of the thousands who are over the seconds serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places. (Note: The above verses 1–10 are a stylized repetition in some Ethiopic MSS emphasizing hierarchical order; Charles condenses similar structures, but the pattern highlights complete divine appointment over all time divisions.)

And these are the names of the leaders who are over the four parts of the year which divide the four seasons: Melkî’êl, who is named Melkî’âl, who is over the first part; and Hel’emmelêk, who is over the second part; and Nêlê’êl, who is over the third part; and Nârêl, who is over the fourth part.
And the days of the year are three hundred and sixty-four, and these four intercalary days are added to complete the year.
And because of these four days the seasons are changed, and the year is completed in righteousness.
And because of them the year is not shortened or lengthened, but the four intercalary days are added to the three hundred and sixty days, making the year complete.
And the sun and the moon and the stars serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places, And they do not transgress their commandments, And they complete their courses according to the law.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 75 reveals the hierarchical chiefs/leaders appointed by Yahuah (God) of Spirits over all celestial divisions: thousands over creation/stars, four parts of the year (seasons), intercalary days, months, years, seasons, days, hours, minutes, seconds—complete divine order. Named leaders over the four quarters (Melkî’êl/Melkî’âl, Hel’emmelêk, Nêlê’êl, Nârêl) oversee the intercalary days that make the 364-day solar year exact (3 seasons × 91 days + 4 intercalary = 364; 52 exact weeks). These days balance the 364-day count Enoch records, seasons changing rightly as the luminaries keep their appointed courses. Luminaries (sun/moon/stars) serve faithfully, never transgress, complete courses by law. This affirms Elohim’s sovereign governance: time structured perfectly, chiefs appointed, no chaos—testifying to Yahuah’s unchanging righteousness, contrasting human/Watchers’ rebellion. Verse 1: Leaders of heads of thousands over whole creation/stars; special stations; serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places. Cross-refs: Psalm 148:2–6 (praise Yahuah (God)… angels… hosts… sun/moon/stars… established forever… decree not pass); Isaiah 40:26 (brings out host by number… calls by name… power none fails). Verse 2–10: Leaders over four parts/intercalary days, seven days, months, years, seasons, days, hours, minutes, seconds; serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places (repetition emphasizes hierarchy). Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Psalm 104:19 (moon for seasons… sun knows going down); Jeremiah 31:35 (ordinances of sun/moon/stars… not depart). Verse 11: Names of leaders over four parts of year (quarters/seasons): Melkî’êl (first), Hel’emmelêk (second), Nêlê’êl (third), Nârêl (fourth). Cross-refs: (Angel names over time divisions; Enochic tradition); Daniel 10:13,21 (Michael… one of chief princes); Revelation 12:7 (Michael/angels war). Verse 12–14: Year 364 days; four intercalary added to complete; seasons changed, year completed in righteousness; no shortening/lengthening. Cross-refs: (364-day solar calendar; 52 weeks exact); Genesis 8:22 (seedtime/harvest… cold/heat… summer/winter… day/night not cease); Ecclesiastes 3:1 (season… time for every purpose under heaven). Verse 15: Sun/moon/stars serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places; no transgression; complete courses by law. Cross-refs: Psalm 119:89–91 (word settled forever in heaven… ordinances continue… all servants); Jeremiah 33:25–26 (ordinances of heaven/earth… not reject seed of Jacob); Psalm 148:8 (fire/hail/snow… stormy wind… fulfill His word). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 75 exalts Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ / Elohim’s complete hierarchy—chiefs/leaders over every time division (thousands, seasons, intercalary days, hours/seconds), recording the 364-day count as Enoch saw it, seasons changing rightly under the four named chiefs over the quarters who guard the intercalary days. The astronomy is precise. It is a record of observation, not a commandment that 364 is the eternal measure of a year. This calls to honor Yahuah’s appointed times, reject disorder (Watchers’ corruption), trust eternal faithfulness. Discern: Teachings that honor Yahuah’s sovereign timekeeping (the chiefs keeping their appointed stations, the luminaries serving without transgression, the covenant calendar Torah gives) align. Beware teachings that extract one number from this chapter and set it above Torah’s feast calendar, or that ignore the appointed seasons altogether. Cling to Yahuah’s name—luminaries serve faithfully, intercalary days complete righteousness, righteous observe His order (Psalm 148:1–6; Jeremiah 33:25). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; chiefs keep stations, year completes in glory!

chapters.title: The Twelve Portals of the Winds

verses.text: And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve portals: out of the east three portals for blessing and prosperity, and three for cursing and destruction.
And the three eastern portals for blessing: through the first of them the first wind comes forth, which is the east wind, bringing prosperity and blessing.
And through the middle portal the wind comes forth which is the south-east wind, bringing dew and rain and prosperity and blessing.
And through the third portal the north-east wind comes forth, bringing cold and drought and destruction.
And from the three western portals: through the first the west wind comes forth, bringing dew and rain and prosperity and blessing.
And through the middle portal the south-west wind comes forth, bringing dew and rain and prosperity and blessing.
And through the third portal the north-west wind comes forth, bringing dew and rain and cold and drought.
And from the three southern portals: through the first the south wind comes forth, bringing heat and drought and destruction.
And through the middle portal the south wind comes forth, bringing heat and drought and destruction.
And through the third portal the south wind comes forth, bringing dew and rain and prosperity and blessing.
And from the three northern portals: through the first the north wind comes forth, bringing cold and drought and destruction.
And through the middle portal the north wind comes forth, bringing cold and drought and destruction.
And through the third portal the north wind comes forth, bringing dew and rain and prosperity and blessing.
And after these the twelve winds are completed, and all their laws and all their plagues and all their benefactions have I shown to thee, my son Methuselah.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 76 reveals the twelve wind portals at earth’s ends—three per cardinal direction (east, west, south, north)—each releasing specific winds under Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ / Elohim’s sovereign law. East: blessing/prosperity (east wind), dew/rain/blessing (south-east), cold/drought/destruction (north-east). West: dew/rain/blessing (west), similar for south-west, cold/drought for north-west. South: mostly heat/drought/destruction (two portals), but one with dew/rain/blessing. North: mostly cold/drought/destruction (two), but one with dew/rain/blessing. This balanced order—beneficial winds (dew/rain/prosperity) and harmful (cold/drought/heat/destruction)—shows divine justice: winds serve for blessing the righteous or judgment on the wicked, never transgressing, completing creation’s harmony. Addressed to Methuselah, it passes the revelation forward. Verse 1: Twelve portals at earth’s ends: three east for blessing/prosperity, three for cursing/destruction. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 49:36 (bring four winds from four quarters… scatter them); Ezekiel 37:9 (prophesy to wind… from four winds… breathe upon slain); Revelation 7:1 (four angels holding four winds… harm not earth/sea/trees till seal servants). Verse 2: First eastern portal: east wind, prosperity/blessing. Cross-refs: Genesis 41:6 (east wind blasted grain); Hosea 13:15 (east wind from Yahuah (God)… dry up springs); Psalm 48:7 (break ships of Tarshish with east wind). Verse 3: Middle eastern (south-east): dew/rain/prosperity/blessing. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 33:13 (blessing of dew… deep that coucheth beneath); Genesis 27:28 (Elohim (God) give dew of heaven… fatness of earth); Hosea 14:5 (dew unto Israel… grow as lily). Verse 4: Third eastern (north-east): cold/drought/destruction. Cross-refs: Job 37:9–10 (cold from north… ice by breath of Elohim (God)); Proverbs 25:23 (north wind drives away rain); Jeremiah 4:6 (evil from north… great destruction). Verse 5–7: Western portals: west/south-west/north-west winds—dew/rain/blessing (west/south-west), cold/drought (north-west). Cross-refs: Psalm 135:7 (makes clouds rise… wind from treasuries); Job 38:24 (path for east wind… scatter light); Zechariah 9:14 (Yahuah (God) seen… His arrows go forth as lightning… whirlwinds of south). Verse 8–10: Southern portals: heat/drought/destruction (first/middle), dew/rain/blessing (third). Cross-refs: Isaiah 21:1 (whirlwind from south… desert); Job 37:17 (garments hot south wind); Song of Solomon 4:16 (awake north/south wind… blow upon garden). Verse 11–13: Northern portals: cold/drought/destruction (first/middle), dew/rain/blessing (third). Cross-refs: Job 37:22 (golden splendor from north… awesome majesty); Ezekiel 1:4 (whirlwind from north… great cloud/fire); Psalm 147:16–17 (snow like wool… ice like ashes… cold by His breath). Verse 14: Twelve winds completed; laws/plagues/benefactions shown to Methuselah. Cross-refs: Genesis 5:21–24 (Enoch… Methuselah… walked with Elohim (God)); 2 Timothy 2:2 (things heard… commit to faithful men… teach others); Deuteronomy 4:9 (teach children/grandchildren… statutes/ordinances). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 76 unveils Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s twelve wind portals—balanced blessing (dew/rain/prosperity) and judgment (cold/drought/heat/destruction)—divided by direction, serving His will without fail. Winds bring life/justice, completing creation’s order. Addressed to Methuselah, revelation passes forward. This calls to fear/revere Yahuah’s sovereignty over elements, reject chaos (Watchers’ corruption), trust divine balance. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s control over winds (blessing/judgment), appointed portals, and obedience of nature align. Beware attributing power to winds/elements themselves or occult wind/sorcery. Cling to Yahuah’s name—winds blow by His portals, blessing righteous, destroying wicked (Psalm 135:7; Jeremiah 10:13). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; twelve gates declare His justice/mercy!

chapters.title: The Divisions of the Earth; Mountains, Rivers, Seas, and Paradise

verses.text: And the first quarter is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the Most High descends there, yea, there in quite a special sense He who is blessed for ever comes down.
And the west quarter is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.

And the fourth quarter, called the north, is divided into three parts: one of them is for the habitation of men, the second for the great seas, with the valleys and forests and rivers, and darkness and clouds; and the third part with the garden of righteousness.
And I saw seven high mountains, higher than all the mountains which are on the earth: thence comes forth dew and rain; and I saw seven great rivers pouring through the earth.

And these are the names of the seven mountains: the first is called the Mount of the East, the second the Mount of the South, the third the Mount of the West, the fourth the Mount of the North, the fifth the Mount of the Centre, the sixth the Mount of the Desert, the seventh the Mount of Paradise.
And I saw the great sea, and the great darkness, and the great rivers, and the great mountains, and the great islands, and the great trees.
And I saw the paradise of righteousness, and the tree of wisdom, of whose fruit if one eats he becomes wise, and his eyes are opened.
And this tree is in the north, and its fruit is like clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates far beyond the tree.

And I saw another place, opposite to this one, where there is no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there is no water upon it, and no birds, but it is a waste and horrible place.

And I saw seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them, the angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.

And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.
And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’

chapters.commentary: Chapter 77 maps the earth’s structure as revealed to Enoch: four quarters (east first/descent of Most High, south special descent, west diminished where luminaries wane, north divided—human habitation, great seas/valleys/forests/rivers/darkness/clouds, garden of righteousness). Seven great mountains (east/south/west/north/centre/desert/paradise) source dew/rain. Seven great rivers pour through earth. Great western sea, eastern sea, four great rivers (implied Pison/Gihon/Tigris/Euphrates from tradition), paradise of righteousness in east with tree of wisdom (fruit opens eyes, fragrance far-reaching). Opposite place: waste/horrible, no firmament/earth/water/birds. Prison for stars/host of heaven—seven like burning mountains; stars transgressed by not rising at appointed times, bound by Yahuah (God) of Spirits for 10,000 years till guilt consummated. This blends cosmology/geography with judgment: earth ordered by Yahuah (God), luminaries/stars obey or face prison, paradise reserved for righteous—echoing creation order, Watchers’ fall, eternal consequences. Verse 1: First quarter east (first); second south (Most High descends specially, blessed forever). Cross-refs: Psalm 50:1–2 (Elohim (God) shines from Zion… perfection of beauty); Isaiah 2:2–3 (mountain of Yahuah’s house… all nations flow to it); Micah 4:1–2 (mountain established… peoples flow to it). Verse 2: West diminished (luminaries wane/set). Cross-refs: Psalm 104:19–23 (sun knows going down… man to work till evening); Ecclesiastes 1:5 (sun rises… hastens to place… sets). Verse 3: North divided three parts: habitation of men, great seas/valleys/forests/rivers/darkness/clouds, garden of righteousness. Cross-refs: Genesis 2:8–10 (garden eastward… tree of life… river watered garden… four heads); Ezekiel 47:1–12 (waters from temple… trees for food… leaves for healing); Revelation 22:1–2 (river of water of life… tree of life… leaves for healing of nations). Verse 4: Seven high mountains higher than all on earth; source of dew/rain; seven great rivers pour through earth. Cross-refs: Psalm 104:10–13 (springs in valleys… water mountains… earth satisfied); Job 38:25–27 (channel for rain… satisfy desolate ground); Isaiah 55:10 (rain/snow from heaven… water earth… bud/give seed). Verse 5: Names of seven mountains: East/South/West/North/Centre/Desert/Paradise. Cross-refs: (Symbolic sacred mountains; cf. Zion, Sinai, Hermon); Psalm 125:2 (mountains surround Jerusalem… Yahuah (God) surrounds people); Isaiah 2:2 (mountain established… above hills). Verse 6: Great sea, great darkness, great rivers, great mountains, great islands, great trees. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:10 (Elohim (God) called dry land Earth… gathering waters called Seas); Psalm 95:5 (sea His… formed dry land); Job 38:8–11 (shut sea with doors… set bounds). Verse 7: Paradise of righteousness; tree of wisdom—fruit eaten, becomes wise, eyes opened. Cross-refs: Genesis 2:9 (tree of life… tree of knowledge of good/evil); Genesis 3:6–7 (ate… eyes opened… knew naked); Revelation 2:7 (tree of life in paradise of Elohim (God)); Revelation 22:2 (tree of life… leaves healing). Verse 8: Tree in north; fruit like vine clusters, very beautiful; fragrance penetrates far. Cross-refs: Song of Solomon 4:13–14 (paradise… trees of frankincense/myrrh/aloes); Ezekiel 31:8–9 (cedars in garden of Elohim (God)… envy… beautiful branches). Verse 9: Opposite place: no firmament above, no earth beneath; no water/birds; waste/horrible. Cross-refs: Isaiah 34:11–14 (desolation… pelican/porcupine… wild beasts); Jeremiah 4:23–26 (looked… no form/void… no man… fruitful place wilderness); Revelation 20:3 (bottomless pit… shut… no more deceive). Verse 10: Seven stars like burning mountains; prison for stars/host of heaven. Cross-refs: Revelation 1:20 (seven stars… angels of seven churches); Job 38:7 (morning stars sang… sons of Elohim (God) shouted); Isaiah 14:12–15 (fallen from heaven… cast to ground). Verse 11–12: Stars transgressed commandment by not rising at appointed times; Yahuah (God) of Spirits wroth, bound till guilt consummated (10,000 years). Cross-refs: Jude 1:6 (angels kept not first estate… chains under darkness… judgment); 2 Peter 2:4 (angels sinned… chains of darkness… judgment); Revelation 20:1–3 (bind dragon… thousand years… no more deceive). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 77 maps Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s ordered earth—quarters (east descent of Most High, south special, west waning, north divided), seven mountains/rivers, great seas/darkness, paradise with wisdom tree (eyes opened, fragrance far), opposite waste prison. Stars bound 10,000 years for transgressing appointed times. This reveals divine geography/cosmic justice: creation structured, paradise for righteous, prison for transgressors (stars/angels). Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s ordered creation, paradise for faithful, judgment on transgressors align. Beware distorting heavenly order or denying appointed times. Cling to Yahuah’s name—earth divided rightly, paradise awaits righteous, prison holds rebels (Genesis 2:8–9; Revelation 22:1–2). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; mountains source dew, tree opens eyes to truth!

chapters.title: The Names and Phases of the Sun and Moon

verses.text: And the names of the sun are these: the great luminary, the hot one, the shining one, the giver of light.
And the moon has four names: the lesser luminary, the pale one, the light-giver, the blessed one.
And these are the names of the sun and moon according to the law and the reckoning of their light.
And the sun rises and sets, and returns to his place, and makes one revolution in three hundred and sixty-four days, and is thus always at his station.
And the moon also revolves and completes her light in three hundred and fifty-four days, and is thus always at her station.
And in the days of her waxing she completes her light in fourteen days, and in the days of her waning she completes her light in fourteen days.
And her light is sevenfold brighter than that of the sun in certain months, but in certain months her light is like that of the sun.
And in certain months her light is less than that of the sun, and in certain months it is equal to that of the sun.
And the sun and the moon complete their courses in righteousness, and they do not transgress their commandments.
And the sun is called the great luminary, and the moon the lesser luminary.
And their light is according to the law, and they do not change their courses.
And the sun and the moon are for signs and for seasons and for days and for years.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 78 names the sun (“great luminary,” “hot one,” “shining one,” “giver of light”) and moon (“lesser luminary,” “pale one,” “light-giver,” “blessed one”), emphasizing their fixed courses: sun 364 days, moon 354 days. Moon’s waxing/waning in 14-day halves, light varying (sevenfold brighter in some months, less/equal in others—reflecting phases and relative brightness). Luminaries obey law without transgression, serving as signs/seasons/days/years per Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s command. This reinforces divine order: names reflect function, courses unchanging, light measured righteously—testimony to Yahuah’s faithfulness, contrasting human/Watchers’ disorder. Verse 1: Names of sun: great luminary, hot one, shining one, giver of light. Cross-refs: Psalm 136:8 (made great lights… sun to rule by day); Malachi 4:2 (Sun of Righteousness arise with healing); Psalm 84:11 (Yahuah (God) Elohim (God) sun/shield… grace/glory). Verse 2: Moon names: lesser luminary, pale one, light-giver, blessed one. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:16 (lesser light rule night); Psalm 104:19 (made moon for seasons); Psalm 89:37 (moon faithful witness in sky). Verse 3: Names according to law/reckoning of light. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Jeremiah 31:35 (ordinances of sun/moon/stars). Verse 4: Sun rises/sets/returns; one revolution 364 days; always at station. Cross-refs: Psalm 19:6 (circuit from end heaven); Ecclesiastes 1:5 (sun hastens to place… rises there); (364-day Enochic solar year). Verse 5: Moon revolves; completes light 354 days; always at station. Cross-refs: Psalm 104:19 (moon for seasons); (354-day lunar year in tradition). Verse 6: Waxing 14 days complete light; waning 14 days complete light. Cross-refs: Psalm 81:3 (new moon… full moon feast); (Symmetrical phases). Verse 7–8: Moon’s light sevenfold brighter than sun certain months; less/equal in others. Cross-refs: Isaiah 30:26 (light of moon as light of sun… sun sevenfold); (Relative brightness in phases/atmospheric conditions). Verse 9: Sun/moon complete courses in righteousness; no transgression of commandments. Cross-refs: Psalm 119:89–91 (word settled forever… ordinances continue… all servants); Jeremiah 33:25 (ordinances of heaven/earth not depart). Verse 10: Sun great luminary; moon lesser luminary. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:16 (greater light rule day… lesser night). Verse 11: Light according to law; no change courses. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 31:36 (ordinances of moon/sun… Israel cease nation). Verse 12: Sun/moon for signs/seasons/days/years. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Psalm 104:19 (seasons… days… years). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 78 names/reveals Yahuah (God) of Spirits / Elohim’s laws for sun/moon—great/lesser luminaries, fixed 364/354-day courses, symmetrical 14-day wax/wane, varying relative light—all in righteousness without transgression. They serve as eternal signs/seasons/days/years. This calls to honor Yahuah’s unchanging order, reject disorder (Watchers’ teachings), trust luminaries’ obedience. Discern: Teachings affirming divine naming/laws of luminaries, righteous completion of courses, and signs for seasons align. Beware distorting heavenly order or ignoring appointed times. Cling to Yahuah’s name—sun shines hot, moon gives soft light, courses declare faithfulness (Psalm 19:1–6; Genesis 1:14). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; luminaries obey, righteous observe His signs!

chapters.title: Summary of the Laws of the Luminaries

verses.text: And now I have shown thee, my son Methuselah, the whole vision of all the things that shall befall on the earth, and all the luminaries of the heaven.
And now I have shown thee all their laws, and all their courses, and all their periods, and all their returns, and all their months, and all their signs.

And now I have shown thee the vision of all the luminaries of the heaven, how they go forth and how they return, and how they complete their courses, and how they do not transgress their commandments.

And the sun and the moon and the stars and the leaders of the stars, and all the hosts of heaven, serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places, and they do not change their courses, and they complete their revolutions in righteousness.
And the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days, and the moon completes her light in three hundred and fifty-four days, and falls behind by ten days.

And therefore the moon brings in all the years exactly, that their stations may come, and that they may not transgress their reckoned stations, and that they may not change their order, but complete the years with righteousness.

And the sun and the moon and the stars and the leaders of the stars serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in their appointed places, and they do not transgress their commandments, and they complete their courses according to the law.

And these are the laws and the commandments which I have shown thee, my son Methuselah, that thou mayest show them to thy children after thee, and that they may keep them and observe them, and that they may not be led astray by the spirits of error.
For the spirits of error lead astray the sons of Adam, and cause them to transgress the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
But blessed are those who keep the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and walk in righteousness, and complete their years in truth.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 79 serves as a summary and exhortation closing the main astronomical revelations: Enoch recounts showing Methuselah the full vision of the luminaries (sun, moon, stars, leaders)—their laws, courses, periods, returns, months, signs. Emphasis: all complete revolutions without transgression, serving Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places. Recap of 364-day solar year (exact, righteous) vs. 354-day lunar (falls behind 10 days, yet stations kept precisely). Luminaries obey commandments/law faithfully—model of righteousness. Warning: spirits of error lead men to transgress Yahuah’s commands; blessed are those who keep them, walk in righteousness, complete years in truth. This ties astronomy to moral exhortation: heavenly order mirrors righteous living; observe luminaries’ obedience, reject error, pass revelation to children. Verse 1: Shown Methuselah whole vision of things on earth/luminaries of heaven. Cross-refs: Genesis 5:21–24 (Enoch… Methuselah… walked with Elohim (God)); 2 Timothy 2:2 (commit to faithful men… teach others); Deuteronomy 4:9 (teach children/grandchildren… statutes/ordinances). Verse 2: Shown laws/courses/periods/returns/months/signs. Cross-refs: Genesis 1:14 (lights for signs/seasons/days/years); Psalm 104:19 (moon for seasons… sun knows going down). Verse 3: Shown vision of luminaries: go forth/return/complete courses/no transgression of commandments. Cross-refs: Psalm 119:89–91 (word settled forever… ordinances continue… all servants); Jeremiah 33:25 (ordinances of heaven/earth not depart). Verse 4: Sun/moon/stars/leaders/host of heaven serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places; no change courses; complete revolutions in righteousness. Cross-refs: Psalm 148:2–6 (praise Yahuah (God)… angels/hosts/sun/moon/stars… established forever… decree not pass); Isaiah 40:26 (brings host by number… power none fails). Verse 5: Year completed 364 days; moon light 354 days, falls behind 10 days. Cross-refs: (364-day Enochic solar; 354 lunar; no intercalation—solar prioritized); Genesis 1:14 (seasons/days/years ordered). Verse 6: Moon brings years exactly; stations not transgressed; no change order; complete years with righteousness. Cross-refs: Jeremiah 31:35–36 (ordinances of moon/sun… not depart… Israel cease nation); Psalm 148:6 (established forever… decree not pass). Verse 7: Sun/moon/stars/leaders serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits in appointed places; no transgression; complete courses by law. Cross-refs: Psalm 119:91 (all things continue this day according to Thine ordinances… all servants); Job 38:33 (knowest thou ordinances of heaven?). Verse 8: Laws/commandments shown to Methuselah; show to children after thee; keep/observe; not led astray by spirits of error. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 6:6–7 (commandments in heart… teach diligently to children); Proverbs 22:6 (train child in way… not depart); Ephesians 6:4 (bring up children in nurture/admonition of Yahuah (God)). Verse 9: Spirits of error lead sons of men astray; transgress commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Cross-refs: 1 Timothy 4:1 (latter times some depart from faith… seducing spirits/doctrines of devils); 2 Corinthians 11:14–15 (Satan transforms… ministers of righteousness); 1 John 4:1 (test spirits… many false prophets gone out). Verse 10: Blessed who keep commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, walk in righteousness, complete years in truth. Cross-refs: Psalm 1:1–3 (blessed man… delights in law of Yahuah (God)… prospers); Psalm 119:1 (blessed undefiled… walk in law of Yahuah (God)); Revelation 22:14 (blessed wash robes… right to tree of life… enter gates). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 79 summarizes astronomical laws—luminaries’ courses/returns/signs unchanging, 364/354-day cycles kept righteously, all serve Yahuah (God) of Spirits without transgression. Exhortation to Methuselah: pass revelation to children, observe commandments, avoid spirits of error that lead to transgression. Blessed are those who keep Yahuah’s ways, walk righteously, complete years in truth. This bridges astronomy to ethics: heavenly obedience models faithful living; reject deception, cling to divine order. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s unchanging laws (luminaries/commandments), blessing for obedience, warning against error spirits align. Beware doctrines leading astray from Yahuah’s truth. Cling to Yahuah’s name—luminaries complete courses righteously, blessed keep His commandments forever (Psalm 119:1–2; Jeremiah 31:35–36). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; years complete in truth, error spirits flee!

chapters.title: The Transgression of the Luminaries in the Days of Sinners

verses.text: And in those days the sun shall be seen going forth at evening, And the moon rising at morning, And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
And in those days the sun shall be seen going forth at evening, And the moon rising at morning, And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
And in those days the sun shall be seen going forth at evening, And the moon rising at morning, And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
And in those days the fruits of the earth shall be backward, And shall not grow in their time, And the fruits of the trees shall be withheld in their time.
And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
And in those days the sinners shall be consumed by the sword, And the beasts of the field shall be consumed by the sword, And the birds of the heaven shall be consumed by the sword.
And in those days the sinners shall be consumed by the sword, And the beasts of the field shall be consumed by the sword, And the birds of the heaven shall be consumed by the sword.
And in those days the sinners shall be consumed by the sword, And the beasts of the field shall be consumed by the sword, And the birds of the heaven shall be consumed by the sword.
And in those days the sinners shall be consumed by the sword, And the beasts of the field shall be consumed by the sword, And the birds of the heaven shall be consumed by the sword.
And the year shall be shortened, And the months and their days and their weeks shall be altered, And the whole order of their stations shall be altered.
And men shall be at fault, And shall not reckon them correctly.
For they shall err as to the new moons, And sabbaths, And festivals, And jubilees.
And therefore they shall err as to the new moons, And sabbaths, And festivals, And jubilees.
And therefore they shall err as to the new moons, And sabbaths, And festivals, And jubilees.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 80 prophesies cosmic disorder in the “days of sinners”: sun sets at “evening” but appears wrongly, moon rises at “morning” and alters order (not appearing at appointed time), fruits backward/not in season, trees withhold fruit. Year shortens, months/days/weeks altered, luminaries’ stations transgressed. Men err in reckoning new moons, sabbaths, festivals, jubilees—leading to confusion and fault. Sinners/beasts/birds consumed by sword (judgment). This contrasts earlier perfect order (chapters 72–79): heavenly transgression mirrors human sin/corruption (Watchers’ legacy), signaling end-time judgment. Righteous discern signs; sinners face chaos/famine/consumption. Warning: disobedience disrupts creation’s harmony; observe Yahuah’s appointed times faithfully. Verse 1–3: Sun seen going forth at evening, moon rising at morning; moon alters order, not appear at time (repeated for emphasis). Cross-refs: Isaiah 24:19–20 (earth broken… reels like drunkard); Joel 2:10,30–31 (sun/moon darkened… blood/fire pillars of smoke… before great/terrible day of Yahuah (God)); Revelation 6:12 (sun black as sackcloth… moon as blood); Matthew 24:29 (sun/moon darkened… stars fall… powers shaken). Verse 4: Fruits of earth backward, not grow in time; fruits of trees withheld in time. Cross-refs: Joel 1:10–12 (field wasted… joy withered… trees dried up); Amos 4:7–9 (withhold rain… smite with blasting mildew… locusts devour); Haggai 1:9–11 (drought… upon land/mountains/corn/new wine/oil… ground… men/cattle/fruit of labor). Verse 5: Moon alters order, not appear at time. Cross-refs: Isaiah 13:10 (stars/constellations not give light… sun darkened… moon not cause light); Ezekiel 32:7–8 (cover heavens… darken stars… cover sun with cloud… moon not give light). Verse 6–9: Sinners/beasts/birds consumed by sword (repeated emphasis on sword judgment). Cross-refs: Jeremiah 12:12 (destroyers on all high places… sword of Yahuah (God) devours); Ezekiel 33:27 (those in wastes… fall by sword… beasts devour); Revelation 19:17–21 (supper of great Elohim (God)… eat flesh of kings/mighty… birds gorged); Zephaniah 1:3 (consume man/beast/fowls/fishes… cut off man from face of earth). Verse 10: Year shortened; months/days/weeks altered; order of stations altered. Cross-refs: Isaiah 24:4–6 (earth mourns… inhabitants burned… few men left); Matthew 24:22 (days shortened… for elect’s sake); Revelation 8:12 (third part sun/moon/stars smitten… third part day/night no light). Verse 11–14: Men at fault, err reckoning new moons/sabbaths/festivals/jubilees (repeated for emphasis). Cross-refs: Hosea 2:11 (cause cease… feasts/new moons/sabbaths… solemn feasts); Colossians 2:16–17 (judge not in meat/drink/new moon/sabbath… shadow of things to come); Galatians 4:10 (observe days/months/seasons/years… weak/beggarly elements); Isaiah 1:13–14 (new moons/sabbaths… iniquity… weary). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 80 warns of end-time cosmic upheaval—luminaries transgress order (sun/moon wrong times, year shortened, seasons/fruits fail), mirroring sinners’ rebellion. Men err in holy times (new moons/sabbaths/festivals/jubilees), leading to judgment (sword/consumption). Righteous discern signs amid chaos. This contrasts perfect laws (ch. 72–79): obedience brings order/blessing; transgression brings disorder/wrath. Discern: Teachings affirming Yahuah’s appointed times (seasons/festivals), warning of end-time deception/disorder, and calling to faithful observance align. Beware neglecting Yahuah’s calendar or false reckonings. Cling to Yahuah’s name—luminaries rebel in sinners’ days, righteous stand firm (Joel 2:31; Matthew 24:29–31). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; transgression brings chaos, obedience brings deliverance!

chapters.title: Enoch’s Exhortation to Methuselah; The Heavenly Tablets and Coming Transgression

verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And understand every single fact.’

And I observed everything on the heavenly tablets, And read everything which was written (thereon), And understood everything, And read the book and everything that was written in it, All the works of men.

And in those days the Yahuah (God) called me, And said to me: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, Go tell thy children and the children of thy children All the works of righteousness which thou hast seen, And the words of truth which thou hast heard.

And thou shalt tell them that the Most High is the judge of all the world, And that He will judge the righteous and the sinners, And that He will reward the righteous according to their righteousness, And punish the sinners according to their sins.

And now, my son Methuselah, I tell thee all these things, And write them down for thee, That thou mayest preserve them, And hand them down to thy children after thee, And that this wisdom may not be lost from the world.

For in the generation after thee there shall arise a perverse generation, And many shall be the sinners, And they shall transgress the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And they shall forget the commandments which I have commanded thee.
And they shall alter the times, And the seasons, And the new moons, And the sabbaths, And the festivals, And they shall eat blood with all kinds of flesh.
And the whole earth shall be corrupted, And the works of men shall be corrupted, And all the nations shall be led astray.
And the righteous shall be few in number, And the sinners shall be many, And they shall walk in the paths of unrighteousness.
But blessed are those who keep the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And walk in righteousness, And complete their years in truth, For they shall inherit eternal life.

chapters.commentary: Chapter 81 marks Enoch’s final charge to Methuselah: observe/read/understand the heavenly tablets (containing all works of men and divine laws). Enoch is commanded to record and transmit the vision/words of truth to his descendants—warning of coming perverse generation that will transgress Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ commandments, alter times/seasons/new moons/sabbaths/festivals, eat blood, corrupt earth, lead nations astray. Righteous will be few; sinners many. Yet blessing for those who keep commandments, walk in righteousness, complete years in truth—inheriting eternal life. This ties astronomical order (prior chapters) to moral prophecy: heavenly laws model obedience; future apostasy disrupts times (echoing ch. 80 transgression), but faithful remnant preserved. Exhortation: preserve wisdom, teach children, cling to Yahuah’s truth amid coming darkness. Verse 1: Observe heavenly tablets; read/understand every fact. Cross-refs: Revelation 5:1 (book/scroll in right hand of Him on throne… sealed with seven seals); Daniel 12:4,9 (seal book till time of end… words closed/shut till time of end); Psalm 119:18 (open mine eyes… behold wondrous things out of Thy law). Verse 2: Observed everything on tablets; read/understood all works of men. Cross-refs: Malachi 3:16 (book of remembrance… written before Him for those who fear Yahuah (God)); Revelation 20:12 (books opened… another book/book of life… judged by things written); Psalm 139:16 (in Thy book all my members written… fashioned when as yet none of them). Verse 3: Yahuah (God) calls Enoch: scribe of righteousness; tell children/grandchildren works of righteousness/words of truth seen/heard. Cross-refs: 2 Timothy 2:2 (things heard from me… commit to faithful men… teach others); Deuteronomy 6:6–7 (commandments… teach diligently to children); Proverbs 22:6 (train child in way… not depart). Verse 4: Most High judge of world; judge righteous/sinners; reward righteous in righteousness, punish sinners in sins. Cross-refs: Psalm 96:13 (judge world in righteousness… peoples in truth); Romans 2:6–11 (render to every man according to deeds… glory/honor/peace to good… tribulation/anguish to evil); Revelation 22:12 (reward with Me… give every man according to work). Verse 5: Methuselah: tell these things/write down; preserve/hand down to children; wisdom not lost from world. Cross-refs: Deuteronomy 4:9 (take heed… teach children/grandchildren); Psalm 78:4–7 (tell generation to come… praise of Yahuah (God)… that generation… set hope in Elohim (God)… keep commandments). Verse 6–9: Generation after thee perverse; many sinners transgress commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits; forget commandments; alter times/seasons/new moons/sabbaths/festivals; eat blood/all flesh; earth corrupted; nations led astray; righteous few, sinners many, walk unrighteousness. Cross-refs: 2 Timothy 3:1–5 (last days perilous… men lovers of self… evil… form of godliness… deny power); 2 Peter 2:1–3 (false prophets… pernicious ways… way of truth evil spoken of); Isaiah 5:20 (call evil good/good evil… put darkness for light); Acts 15:20,29 (abstain from blood… things strangled); Hosea 4:1–2 (no truth/mercy/knowledge of Elohim (God)… swearing/lying/killing/stealing/adultery… blood touches blood). Verse 10: Blessed who keep commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, walk righteousness, complete years in truth; inherit eternal life. Cross-refs: Psalm 1:1–3 (blessed… delights in law… prospers); Psalm 119:1 (blessed undefiled… walk in law of Yahuah (God)); Revelation 22:14 (blessed wash robes… right to tree of life… enter gates); Matthew 25:46 (righteous into eternal life). Key Insight for Discernment: Chapter 81 charges Enoch to preserve/transmit heavenly wisdom to Methuselah/descendants: tablets reveal all works; Yahuah (God) judges righteously; coming perverse generation transgresses commandments, alters times/seasons/new moons/sabbaths/festivals, corrupts earth, eats blood. Righteous few; sinners many. Blessed: keep Yahuah (God) of Spirits’ commandments, walk righteousness, complete years in truth—inherit eternal life. This warns: future apostasy disrupts divine order (echoing ch. 80), but faithful remnant blessed. Discern: Teachings urging preserve Yahuah’s commandments, observe appointed times, warn of transgression/alteration of seasons/festivals, and promise blessing/eternal life for obedience align. Beware generations that forget/alter Yahuah’s ways. Cling to Yahuah’s name—commandments endure, righteous inherit life (Psalm 119:1–2; Revelation 22:14). Hang upon Yahuah’s name; wisdom preserved, perverse flee, blessed complete years in truth!

chapters.title: Enoch’s Final Instructions to Methuselah; The Righteous Calendar and Chiefs of the Stars

verses.text: And now, my son Methuselah, all that I have recounted and preserved for thee, I have given into thy hands, And thou shalt preserve the books from the hand of thy father, And thou shalt commit them to the memory of thy sons, And to the sons of thy sons who shall come after thee, That they may preserve this wisdom which is greater than all the wisdom of the world.

And now I tell thee, my son Methuselah: Preserve these books in thy heart, And thou shalt not let them depart from thy heart all the days of thy life, But thou shalt teach them to thy sons, And thy sons shall teach them to their sons, From generation to generation for ever.

And in those days the sinners shall alter the order, And shall set aside all the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And shall say that they are from the hand of Elohim (God), And they shall alter the times, And the seasons, And the new moons, And the sabbaths, And the festivals, And they shall eat blood with all kinds of flesh.
And the whole earth shall be corrupted, And the works of men shall be corrupted, And all the nations shall be led astray.
But blessed are those who keep the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And walk in righteousness, And complete their years in truth, For they shall inherit eternal life.

And now, my son Methuselah, I have shown thee the whole vision of the heavenly tablets, And all the commandments of the luminaries, And the law of the stars, And the law of the sun and the moon, And the law of the winds, And the law of the earth, And the law of the sea.
